description: Stable quest identities and evidence ledger. Unknown stages and needs-review records are deliberately not availability claims. Never renumber IDs or delete legacy keys.

questions.summary: Identify the Goodshow meetings and Sabrina willpower/takeover gate order before assigning a precise stage.
Silver Conference and some connecting story beats need verified milestone definitions.
HQ, romance, capture/story combinations and extras need a child-task and completion-migration policy before splitting.

quests.title: Pallet Town: send-off gifts (one per starter, before Viridian)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** each starter gets one gift. The gifts open once you have done **both** of these, in either order: talk to Mom after getting your starter (she gives you the Running Shoes and offers to save your money), and get the Town Map from Daisy. The game won't let you leave Pallet Town northward before that anyway. (Bulbasaur players: Mom's talk alone is enough.) All gifts close for good once Blue's scene in Viridian City has played (Blue stops you south-west of the Pokémon Center, gives you his number and leaves for Indigo Plateau). That scene plays as soon as you walk into Viridian from the Route 1 gatehouse: it sits on the only way into town, so collect your gift before you leave Pallet Town.

**Notes:** Talking again after you get the gift, or after the Viridian scene, gives only flavour lines. The game also contains an unused Lv. 10 Poliwhirl gift for the same house that nobody in the house offers, so only the Poliwag can be obtained.

quests.title: Viridian City: the would-be professor's quiz
Viridian City: the Meowth thief (Charmander starters only)
evidence: **Who gets it:** only players who chose **Charmander** in Oak's lab. Viridian has one "thief" quest per starter, and each rewards you with an Apricorn Ball:

quests.title: Viridian City: the Pikachu thief (Bulbasaur starters only)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** players who chose **Bulbasaur**, after the Route 1 catching tutorial. Before the quest opens, the clerk only advertises the Mart.

**Notes:** Answering No does nothing, so you can try again. If you black out, Pikachu stays where it was. If you talk to it from the wrong side at a spot, it just runs back to the northwest spot. Its chase positions aren't saved: if you leave Viridian and come back, it is back at its first spot (tested in an emulator).

quests.title: Viridian City: the Mankey thief (Pikachu starters only)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** players who chose **Pikachu**, after the Route 1 tutorial.

**Notes:** Losing leaves Mankey in place, so you can try again. Blue's scene in Viridian (he stops you south-west of the Pokémon Center and gives you his number) hides the Mankey. If it played while the quest was running, the Fast Ball would be lost. That can't happen in normal play: the scene sits on the only way into town from Route 1, so it has always played before you can reach the keeper (see [Known issues](known-issues.md#pallet-town-to-pewter-city)). Tested in an emulator: you can't walk around Blue, the way round is a pond.

quests.title: Viridian City: Yellow's first Pokémon (the Gym's Virtue trial)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** anyone, once the Viridian Gym has reopened. Until then the man at the Gym door says Giovanni is away; the Gym reopens after Granny Mae's ultimate-move trial on Two Island, when Blue says he's heading to the Viridian Gym ([Two Island: Granny Mae's ultimate-move trial](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#two-island-granny-maes-ultimate-move-trial)). Then talk to the man just inside the Gym door again, from directly in front of him (coming from the door): he is now the **Virtue examiner**. From the side he only says your virtue qualifies you, and nothing happens. Before that, Yellow only chats about her uncle's Doduo.

**Notes:** This is the Gym's first trial. The Wisdom quiz and the Skill trainers come next (next entry). Yellow's story continues later (Viridian Forest rescue, [romance route](#romance-route-victory-road-confessions-yellows-dates-and-your-house)).

quests.title: Viridian Gym: the Wisdom quiz (two ways to pass)
evidence: **Where:** the second examiner inside the Viridian Gym, after the Virtue trial.

quests.title: Viridian City: Pokémon Academy exchange students (missable early)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** anyone, but only in the early game. Steven and Cynthia leave, and the teacher changes to Earl's lessons, once you have **both delivered Oak's Parcel and beaten Blue on Route 22**.

**Notes:** later on the teacher goes back to asking you to beat the two exchange students, although Steven and Cynthia have gone, so the challenge can't be finished then. For Bulbasaur and Charmander starters this happens when the [Nidoran♀ story with the Apricorn Ball maker](#route-2-east-nidoran-and-the-apricorn-ball-maker-non-pikachu-starters) ends (either answer); for Pikachu starters, after the Team Rocket scene in Viridian Forest. Cosmetic ([Known issues](known-issues.md#pokémon-academy-resets-after-the-apricorn-quest)).

quests.title: Route 2: the Rocket warehouse Poké Ball (starter-dependent gift)
evidence: **Notes:** one-time. If your party is full it says so and you can come back. The ball can be taken before or after the battle. The battle starts only when you talk to the grunt: he asks who you are, and **"I came to take down Team Rocket"** starts it (the grunt, then Ariana). **"I got lost and wandered in"** avoids it; he just tells you to leave. Ariana is far stronger than you at this point (her Tyranitar is Lv. 55), but losing to her doesn't white you out: the scene goes on the same way. Losing to the grunt does.

**Missable:** take the ball before the [Celadon Rocket hideout finale](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#celadon-rocket-warehouse-the-secret-passage-and-the-persian-statue-password), which empties the warehouse.

quests.title: Route 2, north of Viridian Forest: the abandoned Charmander (Pikachu starters only)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** Pikachu starters. It appears after the Viridian Forest Team Rocket scene. You must first hear a Trainer in the **Pewter City Pokémon Center** brag about dumping his "garbage" Charmander by the road. Before that, Charmander "doesn't seem to want to be caught" and nothing happens.

**How it works:**
1. Talk to the Pewter Pokémon Center Trainer (only there for Pikachu starters).
2. Talk to the Charmander and say Yes to "Try to catch it?". You carry it to the Pewter Pokémon Center and Nurse Joy heals it.
3. Its old Trainer turns up: battle **Guitarist Del** (Shinx Lv. 12, Swinub Lv. 11, Nidoran♂ Lv. 10). After he loses, Charmander turns on him and he runs off.
4. Talk to Charmander in the Pokémon Center: "Take it with you?" → Yes.
**Missable:** do this before you win the Cascade Badge. That scene removes the roadside Charmander and the bragging Trainer. Once Charmander is in the Pewter Pokémon Center, it waits there.
**Notes:** Del's battle is a scripted win-or-white-out. Taking Charmander from the Pokémon Center removes it for good.

quests.title: Route 2, north of Viridian Forest: Nidoran♀ and the Apricorn Ball maker (non-Pikachu starters)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** Bulbasaur and Charmander starters, after the Viridian Forest Team Rocket scene.
**Failure:** answering **No** lets him take Nidoran♀. You lose the Apricorn Ball service for good. The man is in Pewter but only sighs about Nidoran♀, and his mother says he's been down.

quests.title: Route 2: the Magcargo fan (show a Pokémon)
Viridian Forest: the runaway Snubbull ($20,000, one-time choice)
evidence:
**How it works:**
1. Talk to the owner in the gatehouse. He offers **$20,000** to bring his Snubbull back. The Snubbull just cries until you've talked to him.
2. Find Snubbull in the forest and talk to it: "Snubbull seems to be having a lot of fun. Take it back with you?"
3. **Yes:** you're taken back to the gatehouse and paid **$20,000**. The owner muses about "hunger training or pain training", and the Pidgey is left alone.
4. **No:** Snubbull stays with its friend for good. There's no reward and it can't be taken back later.

quests.title: Viridian Forest: the flower garden and the Spearow (missable)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** before you have the **Volcano Badge**.
**Missable:** once you have the Volcano Badge she says the Spearow are already gone, even if you never helped. Pikachu starters get the Pidgeot loan (next entry) instead.

quests.title: Viridian Forest: lend her a Pidgeot (Pikachu starters only)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** Pikachu starters who have the Volcano Badge, but not the Earth Badge, and haven't become Champion yet.
**Getting it back:** only after you've entered the Hall of Fame. Talk to her with a free party slot.

quests.title: Viridian Forest: the Honey tree (weekday Bug Pokémon)
evidence: **Notes:** repeatable as long as you have Honey. The Mega Drain tutor in the south-west corner, a few steps south-west of the tree, also charges 1 Honey.
**Getting Honey early:** no shop in Pallet Town, Viridian City or Pewter City sells it, and none lies on the ground there. Before Johto you can get it in two ways, both in Viridian Forest:

- **2 Honey** from the woman by the flowers ([the flower garden and the Spearow](#viridian-forest-the-flower-garden-and-the-spearow-missable)), once, before the Volcano Badge.
- **Wild Pokémon holding Honey:** **Surskit** (night, 4% of grass encounters) holds Honey half the time, and **Combee** (morning, 1%) sometimes holds it. Catch one (or use Thief) and take the item from it in the party menu.

quests.title: Viridian Forest: the rescued Eevee (optional)
evidence: **Where:** where Nurse Joy healed Eevee, in the far north-east corner of the forest (well east of the north exit), after the Team Rocket Eevee story on Route 2 and in the forest.

quests.title: Pewter City: Sitrus Berries → Hard Stone → TM69
evidence: **Notes:** any Hard Stone works for step 3. There are other sources, e.g. Route 36. Both are one-time.

quests.title: Victory Road: "Which one is the real Blue?"
evidence: **Warning:** the wrong answer can't be undone. It makes you fight the real Blue as well, and for female players it closes Blue's romance route.

- **"The right one is the real Blue"** is correct. You fight only the impostor (Blue's team: Blastoise Lv. 97, Arcanine Lv. 96…) and Blue thanks you.
- **"The left one..."** is wrong. You attack the real Blue first (Umbreon Lv. 96, Pidgeot Lv. 97…) and then the impostor. Blue ends up angry, and for female players **Blue's romance route closes**.

quests.title: Victory Road 1F: the fake item ball (Lv. 70 Electrode)
Romance route: Victory Road confessions, Yellow's dates and your house
evidence: **1. Confession (Victory Road, final chapter, before your final Hall of Fame entry):** after each companion's fight, they stay behind to heal. Talk to them again and you get a confession scene if three things are true: the romance route is on, they haven't been locked out, and you haven't confessed to anyone yet. The scene heals your party, except Gold's.
**Warning:** you get **one confession per game**. Talking to the wrong companion first uses it up, so only talk to your chosen partner again after their fight.

| Where | Partner | Player gender |
|---|---|---|
| 1F, north-west part, about a dozen steps south of the stairs up to 2F | Yellow | male |
| 1F, middle of the east side (where Blue stands with his Blastoise), after the "real Blue" choice | Blue | female; needs the correct choice ([see above](#victory-road-which-one-is-the-real-blue)) |
| 2F, west side, a short way east of the stairs down to 1F | Green / Red | either (Green for male, Red for female) |
| 2F, east side, a few steps east of the stairs up to 3F | Gold | female |

**2. Yellow's dates (Viridian City, after your final Hall of Fame entry):** Yellow waits just south of the Mart. She only offers dates if you have made your final Hall of Fame entry, have confessed to someone, and haven't locked her out. Otherwise she just says she's an Ace Trainer now. Menu:
- **Let's have a battle:** Singles or Doubles against Yellow (Pikachu Lv. 92, Omastar Lv. 91, …). Repeatable.
- **Let's go for a walk** (date 1): a trip to the Mt. Silver summit and the hot-spring lodge. Heals your party.
- **Let's go for a walk** (date 2, after date 1): a trip to the Resort Zone with **four Multi Battles in a row** at Yellow's side. Your party is healed before the first and after the last, **not between them**. Losing means a white-out and you replay the date.
- **I want you to meet my mom** (after date 2): she comes to Pallet Town, meets Mom, and leaves Viridian for good. Because of a hack bug, this visit plays Cynthia's version of the scene whoever your partner is: tested in an emulator with Yellow as the partner, Cynthia walks in (see [Known issues](known-issues.md#pallet-town-to-pewter-city)).

**3. Living together (your house):** after the Mom visit, your partner is meant to move into your house, with a "Rest in my room" option that costs a Mail. This step is blocked for every player in the original hack: checking the PC upstairs at that stage does nothing (tested in an emulator; see [Known issues](known-issues.md#pallet-town-to-pewter-city)).

**Notes:** the dates only check that you haven't locked your partner out and that you have confessed to *someone*. They don't check that you confessed to that partner (see [Known issues](known-issues.md#pallet-town-to-pewter-city)).

quests.title: Pallet Town: Lance's visit home (after the final Hall of Fame)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** everyone, once, after your **final** Hall of Fame entry (the one after you beat Giovanni at League HQ; see [The Hall of Fame: what your two entries unlock](07-league-to-cherrygrove.md#the-hall-of-fame-what-your-two-entries-unlock)). The scene starts on its own as soon as you're on the ground floor of your house. Many "after the final Hall of Fame" quests in later pages wait for it.

| Item | Used for |
|---|---|
| **Silver Wing** | [Lugia in the Whirl Islands](11-cianwood-mahogany.md#whirl-islands-catch-lugia-after-the-final-hall-of-fame) |
| **Rainbow Wing** | [Ho-Oh at the Bell Tower](10-ecruteak-olivine.md#dance-theater--bell-tower-catch-ho-oh-after-the-final-hall-of-fame) |
| **Red Orb** | [Groudon in Mt. Moon](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#mt-moon-groudon-post-game-red-orb); with the Blue Orb, [Deoxys on Six Island](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#six-island-deoxys-and-the-lucky-meowth-god-post-game) |
| **Blue Orb** | [Kyogre in the Seafoam Islands](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#seafoam-islands-team-rocket-and-kyogre-league-hq-investigation-and-catching-kyogre) |
| **Jade Orb** | [Rayquaza at Sky Pillar Peak](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#sky-pillar-peak-rayquaza-post-game-jade-orb) |
| **Adamant Orb**, **Lustrous Orb** | [Dialga, Palkia and Giratina](12-lake-of-rage-to-sinjoh.md#dialga-palkia-and-giratina-catch-them-after-lances-visit) |
**Notes:** the Griseous Orb is not among the gifts.

quests.title: Pewter City: finding Brock (the Gym Leader's errands)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** everyone. This is required for the Boulder Badge. Players get stuck because Brock keeps leaving.

Like her brother, she asks every question even after a wrong answer and only tells you at the end ("My woman's intuition tells me that's not right"). Retry at once. Declining her ("How can you refuse...") just ends the talk.
6. Talk to Brock again. He thanks you and leaves. The siblings go back to the Gym and mention a "goddess".
7. Walk up to **Anemone's garden**, about 16 steps east of the Pokémon Center door. The cutscene starts when you walk onto the path 4 steps south of Anemone: Brock is hitting on Anemone, you step in, and he heads back to the Gym.
8. Gym: Brock finally battles you. Losing whites you out; you can try again.

quests.title: Pewter City: the Apricorn Ball maker
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** Bulbasaur and Charmander starters who saved Nidoran♀ on Route 2. Pikachu starters find him here from the start, with no Nidoran♀ story ("I learned to make Apricorn Balls from Mr. Kurt").

**Notes:**
- He and Kurt in Azalea share the same "ball in progress" slot, so only one of them can be making a ball at a time. His balls also count toward Kurt's ball counter. Reaching 10 balls has no effect that we could find.
- **The service ends for good** once you've been through the Slowpoke Well event in Johto. After that he says he's putting ball-making aside to spend time with Nidoran♀.
- If you let its former Trainer take Nidoran♀, he just mopes and never makes balls.

quests.title: Pewter Pokémon Center: Elite Four Bruno (one attempt, before Mt. Moon)
evidence: **Notes:** you get **one try**. The game marks him as done *before* the battle, and losing doesn't white you out. Win or lose, afterwards he only praises your spirit. He leaves once the Mt. Moon roadblock story ends. There's no item reward.

quests.title: Route 3: the old painter's Ralts (Fresh Water errand; before the Cascade Badge)
evidence: **Getting Fresh Water:** the Mt. Moon Square shop sells it for $600, but only after the Mt. Moon roadblock story. The shop stops selling it while Asher's gang holds the spring (see the Mt. Moon Square entry). So in practice you buy it between the roadblock and your Cascade Badge.

**Missable:** when you win the Cascade Badge (Misty hands you TM03 right after), the painter passes away. If you haven't taken Ralts by then, it stays behind with a letter. Read it and say Yes to "Take Ralts with you?" to fight a **wild Lv. 15 Ralts**. Catch it: knocking it out or running away also removes it for good. Losing whites you out and you can retry. The Big Root is gone once he has died.

quests.title: Route 3: the Scyther chase (Charmander starters) / Bug Catcher Kenji (others)
evidence: **Other starters:** he already owns Scyther. Answer Yes to battle him (Scyther Lv. 11, Pinsir Lv. 10). This is a one-time battle with no item.

quests.title: Route 3: Misty's Gyarados, "Comfort Misty?" (romance choice)
evidence: **Warning:** answering No closes Misty's romance route (see below).

- **Yes:** you encourage her and have a battle with her (Starmie Lv. 12, Goldeen Lv. 11, Horsea Lv. 10, Psyduck Lv. 5). Then she goes home.
- **No:** she goes home without a battle, **and this closes Misty's romance route** (her confession in the Cerulean Gym, in the final chapter, checks it). Only the Island Forest wish on Six Island, made before the Dream World, reopens it ([the romance route's central entry](09-ilex-goldenrod.md#romance-route-how-its-unlocked-how-your-partner-is-chosen-and-what-locks-a-partner-out-central-entry)).
**Notes:** either answer puts Misty in Mt. Moon for the roadblock scene.

quests.title: Mt. Moon: what opens the fake guards' roadblock
evidence: **Why players get stuck:** the guard won't start the scene until **all four** companions are waiting in the cave and you have the **Boulder Badge**. Until then he only repeats "The road ahead is under construction!".

**Notes:** Nurse Joy inside the cave heals you before and after. Steven is also in the Cerulean Bike Shop until you beat Misty: talking to him starts a battle straight away (Metang Lv. 20, Aron Lv. 15, Baltoy Lv. 16, Anorith Lv. 17). It's a one-time battle with no item, and losing whites you out.

quests.title: Mt. Moon: the fossil seller
evidence: **How it works:** checking the fossil makes him battle you (Super Nerd Zack: Magnemite Lv. 16, Voltorb Lv. 17, Nosepass Lv. 18). Losing whites you out; check the fossil again to retry. After you win, talk to him: he sells **[Helix Fossil](/items/helix-fossil/)** or **Dome Fossil** for **$5,000 each**, as often as you like.

quests.title: Mt. Moon Square: Asher's gang and the spring (after the Cascade Badge)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** once you've won the Cascade Badge from Misty. The Square's visitors reappear and Asher's gang moves in. The shop stops selling Fresh Water for now.

**How it works:**
1. Talk to any visitor who complains about the gang: the couple just southwest of Asher, the old woman or the old man (a couple of steps left of the shop door and a few steps down), or the clerk inside the shop. Before you do, Asher only asks you politely to wait.
2. Talk to Asher and battle him: Rich Boy Asher, Haunter/Skiploom/Spinda/Lopunny, all Lv. 25. Losing whites you out. Win and the gang leaves.
3. Collect the thank-you gifts.

**Notes:** the couple about 11 steps east and 5 steps south of the shop door (also there only after the Cascade Badge) gives a **Soothe Bell** after their little skit, whether or not you beat Asher. The Clefairy Moonblast tutor (costs 1 Moon Stone) is also hidden until the Cascade Badge, and only dances at night.

quests.title: Mt. Moon: Groudon (post-game, Red Orb)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** after your final Hall of Fame entry, with the **Red Orb** in your Bag. After that entry you wake up at home in Pallet Town, and Lance brings you the legendary items Team Rocket had seized, the Red Orb among them ([Pallet Town: Lance's visit home](01-pallet-to-pewter.md#pallet-town-lances-visit-home-after-the-final-hall-of-fame)). This is after the Team Rocket Groudon story.
**Notes:** losing whites you out, and you can try again. **Knocking it out or running away counts like catching it: Groudon is gone for good** (running away tested in an emulator).

quests.title: Route 5: the Pokémon shelter raid (after the Cascade Badge)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** after the Cascade Badge. **Deadline:** if the raid hasn't happened by the time Sabrina laughs in Pokémon Tower ([Vermilion City to Celadon City](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#pokémon-tower-make-sabrina-laugh-the-marsh-badge-trial)), it's lost: the Pokémon disappear and there's no reward.
**Warning:** No loses the Pokémon for good, and with it the Cleanse Tag, the Magical Leaf tutor and the Swablu reward on Route 11.

**Reward (if you saved it):** inside the house:
- The saved Pokémon wants to travel with you. Talk to it and answer Yes to "Take Bulbasaur/Growlithe along on your journey?" to get **Bulbasaur or Growlithe, Lv. 15** (needs a free party slot).
- The grandfather gives you a **Cleanse Tag**. After that he also teaches **Magical Leaf** for free, as often as you like.

quests.title: Underground Path: the underground battle (story, Cascade Badge)
evidence: **When:** the Underground Path's doorways are open only from the end of the Mt. Moon roadblock story until you rescue Prof. Hale in Rock Tunnel, and again from Team Rocket's takeover of Saffron City; in between, an invisible barrier stops you at each doorway. Do the battle on your way to Vermilion City.

**How it works:** after Blue's win streak you fight a string of opponents: Blue, then four challengers, then Green (Red for female players). Losing to Blue or any of the four challengers whites you out. You **don't have to win the last battle**. If you lose to Green (or Red), she takes the "prize money", and the police raid ends the event either way.

quests.title: Route 24 / Cerulean City: the burglary case → TM Case → TM28 Dig
evidence: **Deadline:** finish the case before Sabrina laughs in Pokémon Tower ([Vermilion City to Celadon City](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#pokémon-tower-make-sabrina-laugh-the-marsh-badge-trial)). That scene closes the case: if you haven't beaten the Route 24 grunt by then, the TM Case and TM28 are lost for good. If you beat him but didn't go back to the officer, only the 2 Cheri Berries are lost (the robbed man still takes the TM Case).
**Notes:** you must talk to **both** suspects before the officer lets you name a culprit. Losing to the grunt whites you out; talk to him again to retry. The TM Case is taken from you in step 5.

quests.title: Cerulean City: King's Rock for TM04
evidence: **Where to get the King's Rock:** the Vermilion sailor's thank-you gift after the construction-site clash, townsfolk side only ([Vermilion City: after the construction-site clash](#vermilion-city-after-the-construction-site-clash)). It's also a gift on Cinnabar Island and in Azalea Town.

quests.title: Cerulean City: lend the kid your Bicycle (→ Amulet Coin)
evidence: **Where:** a boy in south Cerulean, just south-west of the Bike Maniac's house door (west of the Poké Mart). He's there from the start, but he's away during two stretches of the story: from your talk with Blue at the Viridian Gym (after he becomes its Gym Leader) until Misty wins her Cerulean Gym Leader assessment, and again during the League HQ investigation, from one of your League HQ reports until Misty leaves for the Seafoam Islands ([League HQ: the Trainer Affairs Department's investigations](07-league-to-cherrygrove.md#league-hq-the-trainer-affairs-departments-investigations-where-to-go-next)).

**Timing:** you get the Bicycle from the Cerulean Bike Shop in exchange for the Bike Voucher from the Vermilion Pokémon Fan Club ([Vermilion City to Celadon City](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#vermilion-city-the-pokémon-fan-club-three-members--bike-voucher)), so you can lend it before the Rainbow Badge; the reward waits until you have that badge. The offer also disappears after Misty's sparring-match scene on Route 7 ([Vermilion City to Celadon City](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#route-7-mistys-sparring-match-what-closes-the-bicycle-offer)).

quests.title: Route 25: Nugget Bridge's "tasty treat" (say No)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** only before you win the Cascade Badge. Beating Misty removes him, so meet him first if you want the battle.

**How it works:** "Accept the tasty treat?"
- **Yes:** you fall asleep and **he robs you**. He takes $60,000 if you have that much, otherwise $50,000, $40,000, $30,000, $20,000 or $10,000: the highest amount you can cover. With less than $10,000 he takes nothing. You get no battle.
- **No:** he's a Team Rocket grunt (Waiter Akutsu: Luxio Lv. 17, Magby Lv. 17, Munchlax Lv. 18). It's a one-time battle: if you lose, you white out and he's gone anyway.

quests.title: Route 25: the Cerulean Cape Battle Festival (quiz and placing)
Sea Cottage: Bill's grandfather (show him five Pokémon)
evidence: **Where:** Bill's house on Cerulean Cape, after the computer-virus story.

| # | Hint | Pokémon | Reward |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | round, dark, leaves on its head | Oddish | Leaf Stone |
| 2 | loyal Fire type that loves to bark | Growlithe | Fire Stone |
| 3 | big round eyes, sings lullabies | Jigglypuff | Everstone |
| 4 | yellow body, red cheeks, *before it evolves* | **Pichu** (not Pikachu) | Thunder Stone |
| 5 | blue, round, tail like a float (Johto) | Marill | Water Stone |

quests.title: Route 25: Suicune (post-game)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** after the post-game Burned Tower scene where the three beasts run off ([Radio Tower, Ecruteak City and Olivine City](10-ecruteak-olivine.md#burned-tower-prof-hale-molly-and-the-three-beasts-post-game-frees-entei-suicune-raikou)).

quests.title: Cerulean Gym / Cerulean Cape: Misty's romance
evidence: **Confession:** male players only, in the **final chapter**: after you're Champion and have made your live broadcast at the Goldenrod Radio Tower, and **before** your final Hall of Fame entry. You also need the Goldenrod fortune-teller's love reading, and you must **not** have answered No to "Comfort Misty?" on Route 3 (or must have reopened her route with the Six Island wish). Talk to Misty in the Cerulean Gym. She asks "aren't you supposed to be off fighting at the Indigo Plateau?" and the confession follows (this uses up your one confession; your party is healed). **Missable:** after the final Hall of Fame she only offers practice battles.

**Dates:** after your final Hall of Fame entry, talk to Misty in the Gym. Her menu ("Let's go somewhere together", "I want to battle you", "I'm busy. See you later") moves your dates along the same way Yellow's does. **Warning:** winning her [Resort Zone date](04-celadon-fuchsia-saffron.md#resort-zone-mistys-date-the-pal-park-and-the-couples-double-battle) leaves her missing from the Gym, so her later dates stall; save before it ([known issue](known-issues.md#misty-missing-from-cerulean-gym); tested in an emulator).

quests.title: Gym sparring partners: EV training for a Berry
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** each one opens once you have that Gym's Badge (Boulder, Cascade, Thunder). The Cerulean partner is away while the Gym has no Leader (from your talk with Blue at the Viridian Gym until Misty wins her Gym Leader assessment). He also refuses to train you for a while during the League HQ investigation, after Team Rocket's raid on the Cerulean Gym ("We couldn't stop Team Rocket").

quests.title: Vermilion City: feed the Wingull and the Horsea
evidence: **Alternative:** the fisherman about 7 steps east and 2 steps south of the Horsea, just south-east of a house door, is part of the Good Rod quest ([Vermilion City to Celadon City](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#vermilion-city-the-good-rod-show-ryochi-a-horsea)). quests.title: Vermilion City: after the construction-site clash
evidence: **The choice ([Vermilion City to Celadon City](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#vermilion-city-the-construction-site-dispute-choose-a-side)):** the night before the clash, in the Vermilion Pokémon Center, you choose whether to back Green (or Red) and the townsfolk, or Blue and the law. That choice also **closes a romance route**: siding with the townsfolk closes Blue's (female players), and siding with Blue closes Green's (male players). See [the central romance entry](09-ilex-goldenrod.md#romance-route-how-its-unlocked-how-your-partner-is-chosen-and-what-locks-a-partner-out-central-entry).

**Thank-you gifts in town (after the clash):**
- **2 Cheri Berries** from the resident a few steps south-west of the Poké Mart door.
- **King's Rock** from the sailor about 8 steps north of the Harbor entrance, **only if you sided with the townsfolk**. This is the King's Rock for Cerulean's TM04 trade.
- **2 Big Mushrooms** from the woman about 7 steps east and 4 steps south of the Pokémon Center door, **only if you sided with the townsfolk**.
- **Magnet** from the man in the southeast of town, about 16 steps east and 7 steps north of the Harbor entrance.
- Lt. Surge gives a **Light Ball** (a **Thunder Stone** if your starter was Pikachu) after your Gym battle, together with the Radio Card and his phone number. His line is the same whichever side you took.

quests.title: Vermilion City: the construction-site dispute (choose a side)
evidence: Continues in [Vermilion City: after the construction-site clash](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#vermilion-city-after-the-construction-site-clash).

**Where:** the Vermilion Pokémon Center. From the street scene when you first arrive in Vermilion until the clash, Blue stands with his Wartortle in the middle of the room, about six steps up from the door. Green (male player) or Red (female player) stands with Ivysaur on the left (west) side.
**Who gets it / when:** everyone. It's story, but the answer changes gifts and your romance options.

1. Talk to either partner. Blue was turned away at the Gym because the Leader has no time; both ask whether you know what's going on in town. Answering Yes before you've gathered the facts gets "Go ask around town some more".
2. Hear out all six people in town (talking to them is enough):

**Warning:** the next Yes picks your side and locks one partner out of the romance route (see the table below). It can only be undone by the Six Island wish.
3. Go back and answer Yes again. The partner you talk to decides your side:
   - **Blue:** "Are you coming with me?" to help Lt. Surge hold the site entrance against the townsfolk. Yes = **law side**.
   - **Green / Red:** "Will you help me?" to help the townsfolk stop the construction. Yes = **townsfolk side**.
   - Answering No sets nothing; that partner goes it alone ("Tch. I can handle it without you." from Blue, "Looks like it's up to me" from Green/Red). You can ask again.
4. Saying Yes heals your party, ends the day and starts the clash next morning (Lorelei then announces the League's ban). The law side fights two Multi Battles in a row; the townsfolk side fights one, against Lt. Surge and Blue.

Gifts both sides get ([Vermilion City: after the construction-site clash](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#vermilion-city-after-the-construction-site-clash)): 2 Cheri Berries, a Magnet, and Lt. Surge's Light Ball (a Thunder Stone for Pikachu starters).

**Notes:** this is the earliest romance lock in the game. If you want Blue later, side with Blue here; if you want Green (male player) or Red (female player), side with them. The lock is not quite final: the one-time Amulet Coin wish in the Island Forest on Six Island ("I want to be more attractive") lifts it again. Lt. Surge's line after the badge does **not** change with your side: everyone hears the townsfolk version. The King's Rock matters for [Cerulean's TM04 trade](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#cerulean-city-kings-rock-for-tm04).

**If you lose the clash:** you white out and the side choice is reset, so you choose again and can switch sides. The romance lock from your first choice stays, so switching locks out **both** partners (until the Six Island wish). Tested in an emulator up to the first battle: the clash clears your side choice before it starts, and siding with the other partner afterwards keeps the first lock and adds the second. The lost battle itself wasn't played; the white-out is read from the script.

quests.title: Vermilion City: the Good Rod (show Ryochi a Horsea)
evidence:
1. Talk to Ryochi. He asks you to hook a **Horsea** and show it to him. Then "Do you have a Horsea with you?" → Yes → pick it from your party. He only looks; you keep it.
2. Ways to get a Horsea:
   - The wild Horsea in the water on the west side of town, five steps west of the central house's south-east door: feed it 5 Yache Berries and catch it (Lv. 25, [Vermilion City: feed the Wingull and the Horsea](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#vermilion-city-feed-the-wingull-and-the-horsea)).
   - **Easier (townsfolk side only, after the clash, before you get the Good Rod):** after talking to Ryochi, talk to the angler on the south shore, a few steps south-east of the central house's south-east door. He fishes the shore Horsea up for you, or, if it's already gone, just gives you one: **Horsea, Lv. 25** (needs a free party slot, one time). "Don't tell Ryochi I fished up that Horsea for you." He won't help while you're carrying **Oak's Parcel**.
   - Fishing one up with the Old Rod doesn't work: Horsea never appears on the Old Rod.
3. Show it to Ryochi.
**Reward:** **Good Rod**. After that he only talks about the Lake of Rage angler.
**Notes:** showing the wrong Pokémon gets "That's not a Horsea..."; you can retry freely. The angler only helps after you've spoken to Ryochi.

quests.title: Vermilion City: the Pokémon Fan Club (three members → Bike Voucher)
evidence: **How it works:** the chairman won't reward you until you've won over three members. Do them in any order:
**Notes:** this is the only Bike Voucher source found in this page. The Bike Shop checks only for the voucher, with no badge check.

quests.title: Vermilion City: the seaside cook (Shoal Salt + Big Mushroom)
S.S. Anne: Teddiursa's honey and the salt (starts the party)
evidence: **Where:** on board the S.S. Anne, after the boarding speech. The girl with the Teddiursa and her grandfather are in the first north-west cabin (1F north-west rooms, the door at the top left of the hall). The cook is in the kitchen on B1F: take the stairs at the top middle of the hall down, and he's a few steps to the right, next to the fridge. The Captain is in the captain's cabin (1F, far east door).

**Who gets it / when:** everyone. You need it to move the story on: the party (and the hijack after it) starts only when you give the girl Honey **after you've battled the old man in the main hall** (the "old boy", west side of the hall, near Blue). Tested in an emulator.
Save before you board, and follow the steps below in this order.

**If you don't have Honey:** visit the cook in the B1F kitchen. Once the girl has asked for Honey, he explains that he has Honey but needs salt, and offers an exchange. Before you've spoken to her, he only mutters about the missing salt.

**If you don't have Shoal Salt:** buy one from the merchant in the main hall for **$1500**, or from the merchant in the north-west rooms (lower-right cabin) for **$6000** after the cook has asked. You can also bring salt bought before boarding from Vermilion's old street merchant for **$2000**. Exchange one Shoal Salt with the cook for Honey, then return to the girl and choose Yes to give it to her.

After the Honey delivery, the girl thanks you whenever you speak to her. The cook also changes to saying he can make delicious dishes with the Shoal Salt. He says this even if you gave the girl Honey you already carried and never exchanged salt with him: his dialogue follows the completed Honey request. This inconsistency is present in the original Chinese game and doesn't require another salt delivery.

**HM01 (Cut) is not given on this voyage.** The Captain in his cabin never hands it over in a normal game: he only says the party has already started. Tested in an emulator. You get HM01 later from the **new captain of the S.S. Anne**: after Sabrina gives you her Badge in Saffron City, board the ship at Vermilion Harbor and talk to him in the captain's cabin. He gives it to you as his "1000th visitor" if you don't have it. You don't need Cut before then: the game's only Cut trees (Route 10) can be cut with the Cascade Badge even if nobody in your party knows Cut (tested in an emulator).

quests.title: S.S. Anne: the party battles and the missing Teddiursa
evidence: **When:** as soon as the party is announced (see above; the guests already stand in the 1F main hall, west side, from the moment you board).

**How it works:**
1. The waiter with the "special Pokémon food" (hall, far west) won't serve until you've had **all six party battles**:
   - Blue (hall, north-west),
   - the "old boy" (hall, west),
   - the Raticate Gentleman (hall, west),
   - the Trainer at the north of the hall. If you already battled this Trainer in the south-east cabins before the party, that battle counts,
   - the Trainer on the west side who "had my eye on you",
   - the Psychic student of Sabrina's (hall, north).

**Notes:** your Pokémon didn't eat the food, so you and Green/Red fight Team Rocket in three Multi Battles in a row. Losing one whites you out to the top of the main hall, next to the stairs down to B1F, and you try again.

**Ship shop:** from the moment you board until the hijack, the merchant in the hall sells Shoal Salt $1500, TM21 Frustration $4000 (the menu calls it TM63; from rc8 the shop refuses you below $4,000, while rc7 and earlier let you buy with $400 or more and took everything you had left; see [Known issues](known-issues.md#ss-anne-tm-price)), Liechi Berry $800 and Ganlon Berry $800. This is the only time these berries are on sale here. Tested in an emulator: he stands in the hall right after boarding.

quests.title: S.S. Anne: defuse the bomb or the ship sinks (one chance)
evidence: **Where:** B1F engine room, at the far east end of B1F. Before the hijack, a crewman there mutters about "hitting the propeller shaft from the side" and claims to be doing maintenance.
**When:** only between the hijack and your fight with Archie in the captain's cabin.

**How it works:**
1. After the hijack, go down to B1F and talk to the "maintenance" man in the engine room. He admits he planted a bomb and battles you.
2. Beat him and he removes the bomb.
3. Then go up the engine-room ladder and fight Archie. His first battle (Crawdaunt Lv. 40) can be lost: you don't black out, and Blue and Green/Red arrive either way. The final battle is still you alone against Archie (**Walrein Lv. 44, Whiscash Lv. 43, Kingdra Lv. 45**); your friends only deal with his other Pokémon in the scene afterwards. The final battle must be won (see below).

| Bomb | After Archie is beaten |
|---|---|
| **Defused** | Archie flees, the Captain retakes the ship and sails back to Vermilion. Outside, **Lt. Surge gives you a Magnet**. |
| **Not defused** | Archie escapes and the engine blows. The ship sinks; you, Blue and Green/Red survive in life jackets and wake up in the Vermilion Pokémon Center. No Magnet. |

**Why it matters:** the sinking lasts a long time. Later NPCs in Violet City, Olivine City, Ecruteak City (including the photo-album house) and on Victory Road 3F speak as if passengers died, for example a woman whose boyfriend "can never come back". There is no retry on the ship once you've fought Archie. The only way to undo it is the Celebi trip at the Ilex Forest shrine, after your final Hall of Fame entry. You must already have received both Shaymin and Celebi at the shrine. With Celebi as your first healthy Pokémon, pick "I can't watch innocents be killed" and beat Archie there. If Celebi or Shaymin was just shown at the shrine, leave Ilex Forest and come back first.

quests.title: Diglett's Cave: the warm stone in the statue (after the Silver Conference)
evidence: **When:** from the Silver Conference closing ceremony on (right after President Goodshow declares it closed). Before that the statue is only described. It opens at the start of the [League HQ investigation](07-league-to-cherrygrove.md#league-hq-the-trainer-affairs-departments-investigations-where-to-go-next) and stays open.

**Also here (after the final Hall of Fame):** Brock is meant to stand in the north of the cave, near the Route 2 exit, and offer a souvenir photo after your final Hall of Fame entry between 5 and 8 pm. Because of a hack bug he **can never appear**: the time check asks for the hour to be 17, 18 and 19 at the same time.

quests.title: Route 11: the Swablu from the shelter
evidence: Continues [Route 5: the Pokémon shelter raid](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#route-5-the-pokémon-shelter-raid-after-the-cascade-badge).

**Who gets it / when:** anyone who has finished the Route 5 raid, either by winning it or by refusing to help. (Losing the raid battle only whites you out and the raid replays.) Walking up to the girl, from the west or from the north-east, starts the scene.

**How it works:**
1. A Shady Guy tries to catch the girl's (wild) Swablu so he can sell it. You're asked "Stop Swablu from being caught?".
   - **Yes:** battle **Shady Guy Wayne** (Ariados, Swellow, Girafarig, Lv. 22). Win and the girl gives you **2 Leppa Berries**. A loss whites you out and the scene replays.
   - **No:** he catches the Swablu and leaves. The girl cries, and the Swablu part of the quest is over.
2. **Returning the Swablu needs two things:** you **won** the Route 5 raid, and you **took the Pokémon you saved** (Bulbasaur for Pikachu starters, Growlithe for everyone else) from the shelter house. Until then, talking to the Swablu only gets its cry.
3. Talk to the Swablu: "Isn't this the Swablu that belongs to the girl in the house on Route 5? Take Swablu with you?" → Yes. The girl asks whether she can keep looking after it, then "Take Swablu with you?" again:

**Notes:** if you refused to help in the Route 5 raid, the Route 11 scene still plays, but the Swablu can't be returned. The stolen Pokémon doesn't come back anywhere on Route 11. **Missable:** if the raid never happened by the time Sabrina laughs in Pokémon Tower (the start of the Saffron takeover), the game closes it as lost. The Route 11 girl then says her Swablu "got taken away", although no scene played.

quests.title: Route 11: cut the grass or save it (choose a side)
evidence: **Warning:** you only get one choice, and it decides which reward you get and who turns up again on Victory Road 3F. You fight the other one. Your helper says they'll take three of the Pokémon, but the battle is an ordinary single battle.

**Notes:** you only get one choice. The loser leaves. A loss whites you out and you can try again. Victory Road 3F checks which side lost, so the losing side comes back [on Victory Road 3F in the final chapter](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#victory-road-the-indigo-conference-qualifiers-find-the-hidden-staff-member).

quests.title: Route 9: the Squirtle Squad steals your Pokédex (Pikachu starters only)
evidence: **Who gets it:** Pikachu starters only. With other starters, the Poké Ball is a plain **Lum Berry** and none of the following happens.

**How it works:**
1. Pick up the Poké Ball. It explodes, and **your Pokédex is stolen**: it's gone from your menu. The Squirtle gang appears.
2. Walk east to them; the scene starts as you come up below them. Your lead Pokémon says you have to win it back: battle **Squirtle** (Lv. 5). A win returns the Pokédex. A loss whites you out and the scene fires again. The Pokédex stays missing until you win.
3. Two Team Rocket grunts net the worn-out gang. Squirtle escapes, and a police officer appears who wants to arrest it.
4. Walk further east. The grunts beat the officer, then set their Electrike on Squirtle. "Things look bad. Step in and help Squirtle?"
   - **Yes:** Double Battle against the two grunts (Mightyena, Chingling, Spheal / Shuppet, Corphish, Flaaffy, Lv. 17–18). Win and the whole gang is freed. A loss whites you out and the scene fires again.
   - **No:** Squirtle and its friends are taken "to Master Ariana". That branch isn't followed up on Route 9.
5. If you saved them, talk to Squirtle: "Will you take Squirtle as a partner?" → Yes gives **Squirtle, Lv. 5**. The officer keeps the rest of the gang to train as a police squad.

**Notes:** **missable.** When Sabrina laughs in Pokémon Tower (the start of the Saffron takeover), the game closes this quest if you never picked up the Poké Ball, or if you've won the Pokédex back but haven't reached the grunt scene yet. The same step also marks the ball as picked up for **every** starter, so other starters lose the Lum Berry in it if they haven't taken it by then. If your party is full, Squirtle waits for you to make room.

quests.title: Route 9: the Butterfree girl (release it or keep it)
evidence:
**How it works:** she can't decide whether to release her Butterfree so it can breed. The talk can go up to five menus deep (Keep → Day Care → "oh well" → "keeping it is fine" → a last choice). What counts is your **last** answer:
- **She releases it** after "True. Wild Pokémon are prettier.", "Yes, that would be selfish." or "Breeding is sacred. Let it go.".
- **She keeps it** after "...They just say that for money." or "Look around. Shouldn't be hard.".
- "Just passing by" ends the talk at any menu, and you can ask again.

quests.title: Route 9: the Paras mushroom picker (Repel → Zinc)
evidence: **How it works:** he needs a Repel to numb his Paras before picking its mushrooms. Answer Yes while you have a **Repel** and he gives you a **Zinc** (one time). Afterwards he sells Big Mushrooms ($3,000) and TinyMushrooms ($1,000).
**Notes:** he actually takes an **Oak's Parcel** instead of the Repel (see [Known issues](known-issues.md#vermilion-city-to-celadon-city)), so in practice you keep your Repel.

quests.title: Rock Tunnel: hide-and-seek (find four hidden kids)
evidence:
| Friend | Where | How to expose them |
|---|---|---|
| Corner kid | the far south-east corner of the lower level | Talk to him. He battles you. |
| Fake archaeologist | the middle of the lower level | Only after the corner kid: "Believe the schoolkid?" → **No**, then battle. |
| "Pikachu" | the north part of the lower level | "Try to catch it?" → Yes. Then answer **Yes** to both questions (perfect disguise? Pikachu cutest?) to expose him with no battle; any No means a battle. |

quests.title: Power Plant: Zapdos and the ecologist
evidence:
**Before your final Hall of Fame entry:**
1. Talk to Zapdos: "Try to catch it?" → Yes starts a **trainer-style battle against a Lv. 90 Zapdos** (Heat Wave, Thunderbolt, Hurricane, Thunder Wave). You can't catch it. A loss whites you out.
2. Win and the ecologist runs up: "Stop trying to catch Zapdos?". No only makes her plead again. Answer Yes to get **TM25 (Thunder)**. After that, Zapdos only cries until after your final Hall of Fame entry.

**After your final Hall of Fame entry** (the one after you beat Giovanni at League HQ): talk to Zapdos → a **wild Lv. 90 Zapdos** you can catch. If you knock it out, catch it or run, it's gone until your next Hall of Fame entry. There's no TM25 here after the Hall of Fame (another TM25 is on Route 43).

**Team Rocket chain** ([League HQ investigation](07-league-to-cherrygrove.md#league-hq-the-trainer-affairs-departments-investigations-where-to-go-next), round 1, before your final Hall of Fame entry): after the intelligence briefing in the Pokémon League building (the one President Goodshow sends you to), the ecologist at the entrance warns you. Deeper in, Lawrence's grunts attack: a Double Battle against two Grunts (Lv. 63–65). Lawrence then catches Zapdos with a special Ball and leaves for **Moltres on Cinnabar Island**. After the chain ends, the ecologist says Zapdos flew back and asks you to catch it.
**Notes:** the first Zapdos fight is at Lv. 90. It's optional, and TM25 is the only reward. The ecologist herself gives no item.

quests.title: Route 10 / Lavender Town: the girl who waits (the Lavender curse)
evidence: **Notes:** if you never ask for a reading after meeting the girl, nothing happens. Buying the tags uses up the fortune-teller: afterwards she only asks "Have you tried my charms?".

quests.title: Pokémon Tower: side battles and extras
evidence:
These two fights are required along the way; they do **not** both happen on the first climb:
- **Blue at the stairs:** he blocks the whole corridor a few steps west of where you come up from the ground floor. "Challenge Blue?" Yes → **Wartortle Lv. 30, Kadabra Lv. 28, Pidgeotto Lv. 29, Umbreon Lv. 28, Rhyhorn Lv. 28, Exeggutor Lv. 29**. There's no item. He stays there until you beat him, and you need that win much later: the scene in the east room of Team Rocket HQ B3F in Mahogany Town, where Ariana and Lawrence corner Crystal and the second password comes from, only plays after it ([Team Rocket HQ B3F](12-lake-of-rage-to-sinjoh.md#team-rocket-hq-b3f-the-two-passwords-and-the-secret-key-door-continues-battle-frontier-cianwood-city-and-mahogany-towns-mahogany-town--team-rocket-hq)).
- **"Mom"**, on the return climb after Cubone runs out, is an illusion, and she stands on the only way on from the stairs on her floor. "Do as Mom says and go home?" Yes just walks you back and she stays there. You must answer No and win: battle "Mom" (Mr. Mime, Poliwrath, Raichu, Lv. 29–30). The battle also requires the Rock Tunnel scene with Prof. Hale.

These parts are optional:
- **The Magcargo behind the illusions:** in the far west corner of the floor where you fight the two illusion grunts. After you beat the two illusion grunts, "Magcargo can no longer create illusions. Catch it?" → **wild Magcargo, Lv. 40**. Catch it before you take any stairs: knocking it out, catching it or running away all make it disappear, and every staircase reloads the map, which also hides it. **Don't lose:** a loss freezes the game (black screen), so heal and save first (tested in an emulator; see [Known issues](known-issues.md#pokémon-tower-magcargo-loss)).
- **Silph Scope:** after the grunt double battle, a **Silph Scope** appears as an item two steps north of the Magcargo.
- **The lonely ghost girl** (along the north wall of one of the tower floors): "You can see me? ... Play with the little girl for a while?" → Yes: battle School Kid Coco (Raticate, Mightyena, Glameow, Lv. 29) for a **Spell Tag**. After that she teaches **Curse** free, as often as you like.

**Battle the tower's Trainers as you go up on the return climb.** Once you've beaten the two illusion grunts, every tower Trainer you skipped (Medium Colette on Blue's floor, and the illusion "Prof. Oak", "Archie" and "Petrel") is gone the next time a floor loads, for example after a staircase. None of them has an item, so you only miss the battles. Tested in an emulator. The ghost girl stays.

quests.title: Lavender Town: trade Big Pearls for Heart Scales
evidence: **How it works:** trade **one Big Pearl for one Heart Scale**. You can repeat this exchange; it is not a one-time reward.

**Useful route:** after earning the Super Rod, the [Fishing Guru's apprentice on Route 12](04-celadon-fuchsia-saffron.md#route-12-the-fishing-gurus-super-rod) trades Net Balls for Big Pearls. Bring those pearls here, then spend the Heart Scales at [Saffron's move relearner](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#saffron-city-small-extras).

quests.title: Lavender Town: Mr. Fuji's gifts (after the tower)
evidence:
**Where:** the Volunteer Pokémon House (the door about eight steps south of the Pokémon Center door), after Agatha breaks up Team Rocket in the tower.
- **Cubone:** it has grown fond of you. Mr. Fuji asks whether you'll take it. Yes gives **Cubone, Lv. 5** (you need room in your party).
- **Mr. Fuji:** the first talk gives the **Poké Flute**. Talk again for the **Mystery Stone**, the stone Team Rocket was after. quests.title: Pokémon Tower: make Sabrina laugh (the Marsh Badge trial)
evidence: **Where:** Pokémon Tower, Sabrina with her Alakazam. She appears after [the scene in Saffron](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#saffron-gym-sabrinas-willpower-test-and-the-pocket-dimension-before-the-takeover).

**Who gets it / when:** she needs the **Cinnabar Gym badge** (before that: "You're still far too weak.") **and** the Mewtwo scene in the [Detrick lab on Cinnabar Island](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#cinnabar-island-the-detrick-lab-lockdown-door-puzzle-and-mewtwo). Until that scene has played she only says she's "deep in her training", so go to the lab first.

**How it works:**
1. Accept her willpower training (Yes): "Make me laugh."
2. Her menu starts with only **Tell a joke**. Each ghost Pokémon in the tower gives you one more idea. Talk to it after Sabrina has set the task:

3. **Try all four options once each.** Each one fails. After the fourth, you say you won't give up, and she laughs.
4. She says you're strong enough to battle her right here, but a call comes in: Team Rocket has taken over Saffron City. That starts [the Saffron takeover](04-celadon-fuchsia-saffron.md#saffron-city-the-team-rocket-takeover-what-it-closes). Next, meet Sabrina again at Saffron's east gate on Route 8: [getting past the barrier](04-celadon-fuchsia-saffron.md#saffron-city-takeover-getting-past-the-barrier-into-the-city).

Losing whites you out; come back and try again.
   - Go through the door. Talk to the boss at the back of the room and pick one of these answers:

   - Talk to him **again**: he tells you the Collector is **Lawrence, the owner of the Game Corner**.

quests.title: Fuchsia Gym: the fake Kogas and the ninja bell (the Soul Badge trial)
evidence:
**How it works:**
1. On your way in, a cutscene by the Gym shows Granny Kin and a henchman talking about how she has bought off Koga, the Gym Leader and head of Kanto's ninja. Koga himself isn't in the scene, and the real Koga is hidden for now.
2. Inside, four fake Kogas turn out to be disguised ninjas when you talk to them (optional battles). The "Koga" standing eight steps straight north of the entrance is Janine in disguise: beat her, and the real Koga appears.
3. Koga won't explain the challenge until your two friends are there. Fetch them: **Green (male player) / Red (female player)** standing outside in the north-east part of town, five steps west of the Shard trader, and **Blue in the Pokémon Center**. Each heads to the Gym once you've talked to them.
4. With all three in the Gym, step up to Koga: the challenge is to bring back the **ninja bell** from the forest northeast of town. The preserve guard now lets you in.
5. In the forest Blue and your friend (Green, or Red for female players) each take a path. Those two paths are blocked for you ("…already took this path"), so take the remaining one. You find your friend being mobbed by Fearow and fight the **Mean Birds**. Your friend then leads you to the bell, which Blue has already picked up.
6. Blue offers a battle for the bell. You can't refuse (No just repeats the question). Beat **Blue**.
7. Koga appears and makes you battle him at once with your tired team: a single **Venonat, Lv. 80** (answering "No" changes his line, not the battle). A cutscene follows: Granny Kin reveals she paid Koga to get rid of you, and Rocket Executives Ariana, Archie and Maxie turn up. Koga refuses to hand you over and calls you to help. You then fight a **single battle against Executive Maxie** (Ninetales, Camerupt, Torkoal, Blaziken, Magmortar, Magcargo, all Lv. 50). Losing this one doesn't white you out; the story continues either way. Rangers arrive and you're taken back to town.
8. Talk to Koga in the Gym: battle **Koga**.

**Notes:** every loss except the one against Maxie whites you out. Each battle can be retried: walk back into the forest to the same spot and the scene replays from the start of that part. After the badge, Janine offers Attack EV training for a Rawst Berry (see [Gym sparring partners](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#gym-sparring-partners-ev-training-for-a-berry)). **HM03 Surf** lies on the ground in the forest, about ten steps north of the forest entrance and a little to the east. Two other forest items, a Toxic Orb (west of the entrance area) and a Toxic Plate (in the north-west part of the forest), plus Koga's three disciples only appear once the bell story is over.
