evidence: **Who gets it / when:** only if the Route 9 girl **released** her Butterfree. If she kept it, Harlan only says he's waiting for Butterfree to pass.

**How it works:** accept his challenge and beat **Bug Catcher Harlan** (two Butterfree, Lv. 32). He says he'll look after these "abandoned" Butterfree:
- **"Free them. They're off to mate"** → he refuses → **"They were let go to mate"** → he releases both Butterfree to fly south.
- **"Then take good care of them"** (in either menu) → he keeps them.

quests.title: Route 12: the Fishing Guru's Super Rod
evidence: **Reward:** **Super Rod**. After that, his apprentice gives you **Big Pearls for your Net Balls**: 1 Big Pearl for 5 Net Balls, 3 for 15, or 9 for 45, repeatable. Trade each pearl for a Heart Scale at [Lavender's House of Memories](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#lavender-town-trade-big-pearls-for-heart-scales).
**Notes:** if one of the three is still unbeaten, the Guru says his line and nothing else happens. Come back after the last one.

quests.title: Route 12: the TM salesman
Route 12: other optional battles
evidence:
- **Cynthia** (at the north end of Route 12, with Gabite) offers a battle against her new catches (Feebas, Spiritomb, Gabite, Lucario, Lv. 25–30). One time only, no prize. She leaves Route 12 after the meeting with President Goodshow and Lance at Silph Co., so it's missable.
- **Picnicker Lily**, the would-be ninja (in the south part of the route, on the west side): "Want to see?" → Yes → Double Battle → **Poison Barb** (once).

quests.title: Resort Zone (Johto): the broke backpacker
evidence: **Notes:** the Youngster hogging the laptop upstairs teaches Brave Bird if you *don't* fight him for it, and a guest who trained at Granny Mae's dojo teaches Flare Blitz for one Fast Ball per lesson.

quests.title: Resort Zone: Misty's date, the Pal Park and the Couples Double Battle
evidence:
**Notes:** starting the date removes Misty from the Cerulean Gym.
- **If you lose a Couples battle**, you white out and Misty is not in the Gym. Find her at the photo spot at the tip of Cerulean Cape: say Yes to her photo (you need room in your album) and the Cape date plays again. Afterwards she's back in the Gym and you can ask for the Resort Zone date again.
- **If you win**, the date ends in the Gym, but Misty doesn't reappear there or at the Cape, so her next date ("I want you to meet my mom", in Pallet Town) can't be started. The other scenes that send her back to the Gym all belong to the main story, which is over by then, so nothing found brings her back. Save before the date. This looks like a hack bug (tested in an emulator: after the date's ending Misty is neither in the Gym, also after leaving and coming back, nor at the Cape; see [the known issue](known-issues.md#misty-missing-from-cerulean-gym)).

quests.title: Resort Zone: the Pal Park's Fixed Catch mode (wild Pokémon by weekday)
evidence: **Where:** the Pal Park reception building in the Resort Zone (Route 48, open after the Cianwood Gym story).

**Notes:** a Fixed Catch show never ends with a score or a Berry prize: it only counts Pokémon stocked from a GBA game, so leave whenever you like and keep what you caught ([known issue](known-issues.md#pal-park-fixed-catch-show-never-ends), tested in an emulator). Sunday's table is the same as Cerulean Cave's, probably by mistake in the hack. Monday's groups depend on the hour of the DS clock. The weekday tables and Monday's hours were checked in an emulator (each day loads the table listed; on a Monday the receptionist sets out A and D from 7:00 to 18:59), and wild Pokémon met in the park on a Friday, a Sunday and a Monday all came from that day's table; the rest is read from the game's scripts.

quests.title: Silph Co. (Saffron takeover): the employee's Lapras (missable)
evidence: **How it works:** after Jessie & James and the Maxie fight on this floor, talk to the employee in the hostages' room: "Would you like to take [Lapras] with you?" → Yes.

**Notes:** **missable.** The hostages leave at the end of the Rocket Boss battle (win or lose), so take it before you go up to face him. The warehouse items on this floor (PP Max, HP Up, Sacred Ash, Rare Candy) can be picked up once the takeover has started.

quests.title: Saffron City: the Team Rocket takeover (what it closes)
evidence: **Starts:** when Sabrina laughs in Pokémon Tower ([Pokémon Tower: make Sabrina laugh](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#pokémon-tower-make-sabrina-laugh-the-marsh-badge-trial)). **Ends:** after the Rocket Boss scene in the president's office at the top of Silph Co. (win or lose). Lance then gives you a **Vs. Recorder** at the Pokémon Center (see the finale entry below).

**Closed for good when it starts, if not done:**
- the [Route 5 shelter raid](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#route-5-the-pokémon-shelter-raid-after-the-cascade-badge) and the [Route 9 Squirtle Squad](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#route-9-the-squirtle-squad-steals-your-pokédex-pikachu-starters-only)
- the Cerulean burglary case, if you haven't beaten the Route 24 grunt yet ([Route 24 / Cerulean City: the burglary case](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#route-24--cerulean-city-the-burglary-case--tm-case--tm28-dig))
- the [Battle Marathon](#route-15--route-14-the-cape-battle-marathon-missable), and with it the [White Flute](#fuchsia-city-the-dodrio-owners-white-flute-battle-marathon-before-the-saffron-takeover)
- Cynthia's and Steven's battles in Fuchsia, if you already have the Soul Badge ([their entry](#fuchsia-city-cynthia-and-steven-after-the-soul-badge-before-the-saffron-takeover))
- [Goh at the Tropius display](#fuchsia-city-goh-and-the-tropius-on-display-choice-no-reward)
- the Shota step at Silph Co. ([Grandma's treats](#celadon-condominiums--silph-co-5f-grandmas-treats-for-shota-master-ball-missable)); the grandma's errand is closed at the end of the takeover
**Paused during it:** Koga is hidden from the Fuchsia Gym until Saffron is freed.

quests.title: Saffron City (takeover): getting past the barrier into the city
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** everyone. This is the main story, right after Sabrina's call in Pokémon Tower. Players get stuck here because talking to the Leaders seems to do nothing. The step that's easy to miss is going back to Sabrina at the end.

3. **Go back to Sabrina on Route 8.** She says "So you've checked all of Saffron City's other entrances..." and offers to send you in through her other dimension. Answer **Yes**. If you answer No, talk to her again and she asks again; nothing is lost. If she still repeats her first speech, a gate is missing.
4. You land in the **pocket dimension**, the copy of Saffron from [Sabrina's willpower test](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#saffron-gym-sabrinas-willpower-test-and-the-pocket-dimension-before-the-takeover). Go to the house in the south-east, where Mr. Psychic's house stands in the real city, and talk to the caretaker at the back. She gives you the **Sub. Doll** and sends you into the occupied Saffron Gym.
5. In Saffron, Blue turns up (Bill sent him in through the PC storage system) and the two of you fight off the Rockets together. Blue then suggests sneaking into **Silph Co.**, where their boss and the key to the barrier should be.

**Next:** Silph Co. In Rotom's Room, a glowing floor panel leads on to the hostages' floor ([Rotom's Room](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#rotoms-room-silph-co-change-rotoms-form), [the employee's Lapras](#silph-co-saffron-takeover-the-employees-lapras-missable)). Then go up to Ariana and the [president's office](#silph-co-presidents-office-the-goodshow-meeting-and-the-saffron-takeover-finale). Optional on the way: [help Ma Baoguo](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#saffron-city-takeover-help-ma-baoguo-fight-off-team-rocket) outside the Hunyuan Dojo.
**Notes:** Fly can't get you over the barrier either: Lance says it covers the sky. Read from the game's scripts; the Blue scene in step 5 was also played in an emulator.

quests.title: Silph Co. president's office: the Goodshow meeting and the Saffron takeover finale
evidence:
**Where:** the president's office at the top of Silph Co. Two scenes play here:
1. **Before the takeover:** Lance brings you, Blue and Green/Red to meet President Goodshow. He gives you **3 Rare Candies**. The two answers to his question only change one line. This meeting makes the Pokémon Tower ghosts appear for Sabrina's trial ([Pokémon Tower: make Sabrina laugh](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#pokémon-tower-make-sabrina-laugh-the-marsh-badge-trial)).
2. **End of the takeover:** the only way in is the door behind **Ariana** on the Silph Co. top floor. Beat her (losing whites you out) and you walk straight into the office, where the Rocket Boss is pressing the president to join Team Rocket.
**How it works:**
1. The game asks "Team Rocket's boss seems to be talking with Silph's president. Act now?": **Listen a little longer** / **Attack the barrier Pokémon** / **Attack the Rocket Boss directly**. Listening lets you overhear the president hand over Shota's Master Ball, then asks again (barrier or boss only). The choice changes only a few lines: every branch ends the same way.
2. The boss spots you and his Nidoqueen floors you. Your **Sub. Doll** (from the Saffron Gym caretaker, [Saffron Gym: Sabrina's willpower test](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#saffron-gym-sabrinas-willpower-test-and-the-pocket-dimension-before-the-takeover)) takes the final blow, and your Pokémon knocks out the Hypno that powers the barrier.
3. Battle **Rocket Boss** (Nidoqueen, Beedrill, Rhydon, Marowak, Swampert, Sandslash, all Lv. 100). **Losing doesn't white out** and the story goes on either way. If you win, Ariana reports the barrier is cracking and the Rockets flee by train; if you lose, Blue tells you they retreated once the barrier broke.
4. You wake up in the Pokémon Center with your friends. Lance gives you a **Vs. Recorder**, the Sub. Doll is used up, and Saffron is freed.
**Reward:** Vs. Recorder (plus 3 Rare Candies from the earlier meeting).

quests.title: Saffron Gym: Sabrina's willpower test and the pocket dimension (before the takeover)
evidence: **Where:** Sabrina at the back of the Saffron Gym. She's only there **after President Goodshow's meeting at Silph Co.** From the Mt. Moon Square scene until that meeting she's away, and the test can't start.
**Who gets it / when:** any time after that meeting and before the Saffron takeover. You can't battle her for the Marsh Badge until Saffron has been freed (below).

**Notes:** during the takeover, Sabrina's teleport from Route 8 drops you in the same dimension ([Pokémon Tower: make Sabrina laugh](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#pokémon-tower-make-sabrina-laugh-the-marsh-badge-trial), [the Saffron takeover](04-celadon-fuchsia-saffron.md#saffron-city-the-team-rocket-takeover-what-it-closes)). The caretaker then gives you the **Sub. Doll** key item and sends you into the occupied Gym. The Sub. Doll saves you in the Silph Co. finale and is used up there ([the takeover finale](04-celadon-fuchsia-saffron.md#silph-co-presidents-office-the-goodshow-meeting-and-the-saffron-takeover-finale)).

quests.title: Saffron City: Cynthia and Steven (after the League President's meeting)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** both appear after the meeting with President Goodshow at Silph Co. Nothing hides them again, so they're still there after the takeover.

**Notes:** one battle each. A loss whites you out and you can ask again. These aren't the [Fuchsia battles](04-celadon-fuchsia-saffron.md#fuchsia-city-cynthia-and-steven-after-the-soul-badge-before-the-saffron-takeover). Those two vanish at the takeover; these don't.

quests.title: Saffron City: the Copycat's transformation show
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** any time Saffron's townsfolk are out (before or after the Team Rocket takeover, not during it).

**How it works:**
1. **Talk to one of the two friends outside** first. They ask you to hurry her up. Until you do, the girl only says "please don't bother us".
2. Go upstairs in the house and talk to the girl with her Ditto. She wants a performing teacher.
3. Talk to the **magician**. He'll teach her only for a **Twisted Spoon**. There's one in an item ball in the **Magnet Train station**, a few steps right of the entrance; another comes from Route 13. Talk to him again with it and hand it over. He leaves for the house.
4. Talk to the girl again → **Yes** to watch her show. She transforms into you and battles: **Copycat** (Ditto 34, Pikachu 34, Venusaur 35, Charizard 36, Blastoise 36). **Win or lose, the quest goes on.** Losing doesn't white you out.
5. She gives you an **Expert Belt** and goes outside to perform. Talk to her outside to watch her turn into Sabrina (flavour).
6. Talk to the **magician** (now upstairs in the house, next to where she stood). He returns your **Twisted Spoon** and adds a **Silk Scarf**. After that he's the **Extrasensory** tutor (free).
7. Talk to her **father** (downstairs, at the back on the left). He gives you a **Heart Scale** (once).
**Reward:** Expert Belt, Twisted Spoon back, Silk Scarf, Heart Scale, and access to the free Extrasensory tutor.
**Notes:** nothing is missable. If the takeover starts mid-quest, the steps wait until Saffron is freed: the magician is back outside after the liberation (tested in an emulator).

quests.title: Saffron City: show the dog lover a Growlithe (unlocks Fire Punch)
evidence: **Notes:** Arcanine doesn't count; it must be a Growlithe.

quests.title: Saffron City: the Hunyuan Dojo (beat the disciples → Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan)
evidence:
**How it works:**
1. If you first walk in before the takeover, a scene plays: Master Ma "wins" a sparring match against a young man's Hitmonlee and Hitmonchan. If your first visit comes after the takeover, the scene is skipped. Nothing depends on it.
2. **Talk to Ma Baoguo first.** He tells you to beat his disciples. Until you've talked to him, the disciples won't battle.
3. Beat the four disciples. **Pokéfan Enzo** (right side, lower) fights only after the other three.

4. Battle **Ma Baoguo**: one **Machamp, Lv. 69**. A loss against him or a disciple whites you out; try again.
**Reward:** pick **one** of the two Poké Balls by the wall: **Hitmonlee** or **Hitmonchan**, Lv. 35. The other stays sealed. Afterwards talk to Ma again for lessons: "Teach me the Lightning Whip!" teaches **[Volt Switch](/moves/volt-switch/)** and "Receive, Transform, Release!" teaches **Counter**, $10,000 each (only Pokémon on his list can learn them). **Version note:** from rc8 the Lightning Whip always teaches Volt Switch. On rc7 and earlier it was only Volt Switch for a Pokémon that already knew four moves and forgot one; a Pokémon with a free move slot learned **Charge** instead, for the same $10,000 (see [the known issue](known-issues.md#lightning-whip-lesson-teaches-charge)). After Saffron is freed his menu also offers "Teach me a little life experience!": just a speech about Team Rocket, no reward.

quests.title: Saffron City (takeover): help Ma Baoguo fight off Team Rocket
evidence: **Reward:** none, just thanks. After the liberation a resident mentions that Ma "stood up to those thugs" (you hear this either way, whether or not you helped). Optional.

quests.title: Rotom's Room (Silph Co.): change Rotom's form
evidence: **Notes:** repeatable, free. During the takeover the room is guarded by four Grunts who battle you when you talk to them (Lv. 63–65), plus two Trainers who battle you on sight: **Executive Lawrence** (Lv. 73–74), right in front of the elevator door, and a Grunt in the south of the room. Lawrence is a real threat, so come prepared. A glowing floor panel in the south-east corner is your way on to the hostages' floor ([the employee's Lapras](04-celadon-fuchsia-saffron.md#silph-co-saffron-takeover-the-employees-lapras-missable)).

quests.title: Saffron City: small extras
evidence:
- **Choice items (after the Plain Badge):** a merchant just north of the Route 6 gate (Saffron's south exit) sells the **Choice Scarf**, **Choice Specs** and **Choice Band** for **$50,000** each. Before the Plain Badge he has no stock.
- **Mr. Psychic's house** (south-east Saffron, west of the Route 8 gate): the psychic inside makes a Pokémon remember a move for **one Heart Scale** each time. For a repeatable supply, [trade Big Pearls in Lavender Town](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#lavender-town-trade-big-pearls-for-heart-scales).
- **Saffron Gym during the takeover:** a Trainer sheltering just inside the Gym entrance offers a practice battle, repeatable.
- **Sabrina's rematch (after your first Hall of Fame):** she offers a battle, **singles or doubles**, Lv. 89–90, repeatable. It opens after your first Hall of Fame entry (the same unlock as Blaine's rematch). After your final Hall of Fame entry (the one after you beat Giovanni at League HQ) she's **away from the Gym on Fridays** (by the DS clock).

quests.title: Route 19: the surfing Pikachu (Pidgeot lead → Surf for Pikachu)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** after the Soul Badge. Between the Rainbow Badge and the Soul Badge Route 19 is closed ("volcanic ash"), and the kid waits in the gatehouse.

**Notes:** the spot does nothing if Pidgeot isn't in the lead, and nothing if you haven't talked to the kid since the Soul Badge. Answer No and you can step on it again. A TM12 Taunt item ball lies on the same south beach, just below where the kid ends up.

quests.title: Route 21: break the wild Mr. Mime's barrier (unlocks Iron Head)
evidence:
**How it works:**
1. Talk to the Trainer. He orders his Lairon to Iron Head the Mr. Mime's barrier, and fails.
2. Talk to the **Mr. Mime** and answer Yes to "Battle Mr. Mime?": a **wild Lv. 60 Mr. Mime**. You can catch it. Knocking it out or running away also counts.
3. Talk to the Trainer again.
**Reward:** he teaches **Iron Head** for **1 Nest Ball** a time (details on the Move tutors page). Before you beat the Mr. Mime he only talks about the barrier.
**Notes:** losing the battle whites you out; Mr. Mime stays and you can try again. Once it's caught, knocked out or fled from, it's gone for good.

quests.title: Cinnabar Island: finding the hidden Gym (the riddle restaurant)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** on your first visit (story; you need it for the Volcano Badge).

**Notes:** a man outside the restaurant, a few steps west of its door, also spots that Blaine owns it. The Gym's sparring partner (Sp. Atk EVs for a Chesto Berry) works like the others ([Gym sparring partners](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#gym-sparring-partners-ev-training-for-a-berry)).

quests.title: Cinnabar Island: the Detrick lab lockdown (door puzzle) and Mewtwo
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** after the Volcano Badge. Before that the guard at the door turns you away. **This scene is part of the story:** until it has played, Sabrina in the [Pokémon Tower](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#pokémon-tower-make-sabrina-laugh-the-marsh-badge-trial) only says she's "deep in her training", so come here before you go for the Marsh Badge.

**Notes:** the R&D logs on the desk in the south-east part of the lab are four pages; say Yes to keep reading. If you've reached the matching step of the Mew hunt (you've freed the Five Island disciple; see [Five Island: the Island Pilgrimage leg](#five-island-the-island-pilgrimage-leg-five-island-trials)), reading all four makes **Mew** appear and flee, which moves that chain on. After the scene Blaine's staff mourn Amber and Blaine swears revenge on Team Rocket.

quests.title: Cinnabar Island: the Fire-type quiz (unlocks Heat Wave)
evidence: **Notes:** a wrong answer ends the quiz ("Nope. Think about it some more."). Talk to him again to restart from question 1; there's no penalty.

quests.title: Cinnabar Island: the Egg in the lava (Treecko Egg; missable)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** before the League HQ investigation sends you to the Power Plant (round 1, after the Silver Conference; [Power Plant: Zapdos and the ecologist](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#power-plant-zapdos-and-the-ecologist)). That scene removes the man and the Egg for good.

**Notes:** the Egg lies in a nook you can only reach from where the man stands, so you can't take it before the scene. Once Moltres chases him off, step into his spot and pick up the Egg. A Pokémon Center visitor later calls Moltres "a vicious bird that attacks people".

quests.title: Cinnabar Island: small extras
evidence:
- **S.S. Anne painter (with a Smeargle, south-west of the lab door):** thanks you for saving the S.S. Anne and gives **5 King's Rocks** (once). He's only there if the ship didn't sink ([S.S. Anne: defuse the bomb](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#ss-anne-defuse-the-bomb-or-the-ship-sinks-one-chance)), or after [the Celebi trip at the Ilex Forest shrine](09-ilex-goldenrod.md#forest-of-time-celebi-takes-you-back-to-the-ss-anne-post-game-only-if-the-ship-sank) has undone the sinking.
- **Sailor Leroy (just south-west of the Pokémon Center door):** can't find the Cinnabar Gym and challenges you instead. Kingler, Drapion and Kecleon, all Lv. 58. Win for a **Flame Plate** (once).
- **The graffiti couple (a few steps north-east of the Pokémon Center door):** they want to carve their names into the rock. "Stop them from scribbling all over the scenic spot?" Yes → Double Battle, Camper Rusty and Youngster Bowie (Hypno 57, Lucario 58 / Sceptile 58, Skarmory 57), no item. No → they carve it, and that choice sticks. **Losing the battle also lets them carve their names**, for good.
- **Pokémon Center:** a man inside (he grumbles that hardly anyone earns the Volcano Badge) gives **TM50 Overheat** if you show him a **Volcano Badge** (once).
- **Fossil restoring:** a scientist in the room behind the side door on the west of the island (just north of the Pokémon Center) restores Old Amber and the Helix, Dome, Root, Claw, Armor and Skull Fossils. He's straight ahead at the back of the room. He needs time: come back later. The Pokémon arrives at Lv. 20.

quests.title: Seafoam Islands: the ice walls, Articuno and the researcher (TM14 Blizzard)
evidence: **Where:** the deepest chamber of the Seafoam Islands (reached from B4F). A researcher stands just inside the entrance. Further north, three ice blocks close the passage, and Articuno sits a few steps behind them.
**Who gets it / when:** any time you can reach the bottom of the Seafoam Islands.

**How it works:**
1. **The ice:** "Ordinary means won't move it." Talk to the ice with a **Magcargo** or a **Moltres** as your first healthy party Pokémon and it melts away for good. Nothing else works.
2. **Before the final Hall of Fame** (the one after you beat Giovanni at League HQ, not your first entry; see [The Hall of Fame: what your two entries unlock](07-league-to-cherrygrove.md#the-hall-of-fame-what-your-two-entries-unlock)): talk to Articuno. You fight a **Lv. 90 Articuno** in a battle where no Balls can be thrown (Timid, Snow Warning, Sheer Cold / Blizzard / Freeze-Dry / Air Slash). Losing whites you out.
3. Win and it asks "Catch it?". Say Yes and the researcher runs up and begs you to spare Articuno, because catching it could wake Kyogre. "Stop trying to catch Articuno?" No only makes him plead again; Yes gets you **TM14 Blizzard**. After that Articuno just sits there until the final Hall of Fame. Answering No to "Catch it?" does nothing and you can fight it again.
4. **After the final Hall of Fame:** talk to Articuno → "Catch Articuno?" → a **wild Lv. 90 Articuno** you can catch. Once it's caught, knocked out or run from, it's gone.
**Reward:** TM14 Blizzard (the only one in the game) before the final Hall of Fame; Articuno after it. The researcher also teaches **Ice Shard** for free: to players who spared Articuno, and to everyone after the League HQ investigation's Team Rocket scene here (next entry).

**Notes:** **TM14 is missable.** Get it before the Team Rocket scene in the Seafoam Islands during the League HQ investigation (next entry). That scene removes Articuno; it only comes back after [Lance's visit to your home](01-pallet-to-pewter.md#pallet-town-lances-visit-home-after-the-final-hall-of-fame), and by then only the catch battle is left, so TM14 can no longer be obtained. Until that scene, Articuno is there for everyone. (The Route 3 painter's Ralts scene would also remove it, but nothing in the game triggers that scene; see [Known issues](known-issues.md#saffron-city-to-cinnabar-island).)

quests.title: Seafoam Islands: Team Rocket and Kyogre (League HQ investigation), and catching Kyogre
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** during the League HQ investigation (round 2, the [Cerulean Gym lead](07-league-to-cherrygrove.md#league-hq-the-trainer-affairs-departments-investigations-where-to-go-next)), after the Silver Conference. After the Cerulean Gym scene where Archie steals Misty's **Blue Orb** and sends it to the Seafoam Islands, Misty goes ahead. The researcher then says a group rushed down to catch Articuno and Kyogre.

**How it works:**
1. Walk a couple of steps past the researcher into the chamber. Misty joins you for a **Multi Battle** against two Grunts (Lv. 63–65).
2. Lawrence has Moltres melt the ice. Articuno is taken. Second **Multi Battle** with Misty against **Executive Lawrence** (Moltres 90, Zapdos 90, Pidgeot 88, Aerodactyl 88, Staraptor 88, Noctowl 87) and a Grunt (Raichu 65, Claydol 64, Murkrow 63). Losing whites you out; the scene replays.
3. Archie summons **Kyogre** with the Blue Orb and escapes with it. You can't stop him. If this was your last lead, you're told to report to League HQ; otherwise "check somewhere else".
4. **Catching Kyogre (after the final Hall of Fame):** [Lance brings the seized legendary items to your home in Pallet Town](01-pallet-to-pewter.md#pallet-town-lances-visit-home-after-the-final-hall-of-fame), including the **Blue Orb**. Take it to the pedestal at the north end of the chamber and answer Yes to "Use the Blue Orb to summon Kyogre?" → a **wild Lv. 95 Kyogre**.
**Notes:** Kyogre is one attempt: catch it, knock it out or run away and it's gone for good. Losing whites you out and you can retry. The ice walls melted during the scene come back afterwards; melt them yourself (previous entry) to reach Articuno and the pedestal. Articuno doesn't come back after this scene until [Lance's visit](01-pallet-to-pewter.md#pallet-town-lances-visit-home-after-the-final-hall-of-fame).

quests.title: Cinnabar Island: Lawrence and Moltres (League HQ investigation), and catching Moltres
evidence:
**How it works:**
- **After the final Hall of Fame** (the one after you beat Giovanni at League HQ): go to where the Egg man stood and read the lava's edge in front of you (north): "Moltres is staring at you. Try to catch Moltres?" → a **wild Lv. 90 Moltres**. Catch it, knock it out or run away, and it's gone for good. Later Hall of Fame entries don't bring it back.
- **League HQ investigation (round 1, after the [Power Plant](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#power-plant-zapdos-and-the-ecologist) scene):** walking up towards the lava (about four steps south of the lava's edge) triggers Lawrence burning a Paras to lure Moltres. You battle **Executive Lawrence** (Skarmory 87, Aerodactyl 88, Salamence 87, Sirfetch'd 88, Noivern 87, Braviary 88). Losing whites you out and the scene replays. After the battle his Grunts catch Moltres and escape; the investigation then points you to Rock Tunnel or League HQ.

**Notes:** the investigation scene checks only its own progress, so catching the lava Moltres doesn't block it. In normal play the order can't be reversed anyway: the lava Moltres needs the final Hall of Fame, which comes after the investigation.

quests.title: Cinnabar Gym: Blaine rematch (after your first Hall of Fame)

quests.title: Route 42 gatehouse (Ecruteak side): the tourist crowd
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** Johto. A crowd of tourists heading for the red Gyarados blocks the way east.

**How it works:** the crowd doesn't move until you've finished the Team Rocket Executives battle with Gold on **Route 47** ([Route 47: Will, Karen and the Raikou device](12-lake-of-rage-to-sinjoh.md#route-47-will-karen-and-the-raikou-device-story-five-battles-in-a-row)). After that the tourists are gone and the path is open.

quests.title: Two Island: the old captain's Water-type quiz (→ Piplup)

quests.title: Two Island: a partner for Granny Mae's trial

quests.title: Two Island: small extras
evidence:

Anne: defuse the bomb](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#ss-anne-defuse-the-bomb-or-the-ship-sinks-one-chance)), or later undid the sinking with [the Celebi trip at the Ilex Forest shrine](09-ilex-goldenrod.md#forest-of-time-celebi-takes-you-back-to-the-ss-anne-post-game-only-if-the-ship-sank), she gives you **2 Heart Scales**, once.

quests.title: Three Island: the Alto Mare Bikers (save the Meowth?)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** once a man in the One Island Pokémon Center has asked you to drive off the bikers and you've agreed. He only turns up after Gold's battle on Route 39 in Johto (on the way to Olivine City). Until you've agreed, the guards just turn you away. **Missable:** once you clear the Dragon's Den (Clair, Rising Badge), the bikers leave Three Island for good.

**How it works:**
1. Talk to the entrance guards: double battle (Bikers Ivan and Warren, Lv. 62–64). They run to tell their Boss.
2. Pick one of two ways to bring out the Boss:
   - **The house bikers:** double battle → the Boss wakes up → another double battle → the Boss himself (Black Belt Doyle, Breloom Lv. 72 lead).
   - **The Meowth:** the prompt is "Save this Meowth?". Say **Yes** and beat the cat catcher. The Boss comes out and orders his men to grab the Meowth.
3. On the Meowth route, a **talking Meowth** leaps in to protect the stray, "Meowzie", and **Jessie & James** join the fight. Then you're asked **"Help Team Rocket?"**:
   - **Yes:** you battle the Boss (Black Belt Doyle) yourself, then Team Rocket finish the gang. Losing whites you out.
   - **No:** you only watch; Team Rocket beat the bikers by themselves.
   Either way, Meowth then duels Meowzie's Persian "big brother" for her and wins. Meowzie turns him down anyway ("a Meowth that talks like a human is just too creepy!"), and Team Rocket leave.
4. The bikers retreat to their Chief at the **Shipyard Ruins** (continued in [Shipyard Ruins: the bikers' Chief](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#shipyard-ruins-three-island-the-bikers-chief-a-bribe-or-a-fight)). A biker at the top of the bridge south of the town won't let you through until you've talked to [Big Sis](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#three-island-the-biker-big-sis-who-cant-ride), in the southern of the two houses, right next to him.

**Reward:** no item for the fight itself. The story ends at the [Shipyard Ruins](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#shipyard-ruins-three-island-the-bikers-chief-a-bribe-or-a-fight): winning the gauntlet there earns a **Protector** (missable: before you clear the Dragon's Den); taking the Chief's bribe costs you a $400,000 fine later.
**Notes:** saying "No" to "Save this Meowth?" does nothing; you can talk to him again. The "Help Team Rocket?" choice only decides whether you fight the Boss.

quests.title: Three Island → Six Island: the lost daughter (Three Island's pilgrimage trial)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** the Three Island chief sets this as your Island Pilgrimage trial: help the tourists ([Three Island: the engineer's trial](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#three-island-the-engineers-trial)). The father only stands on Three Island once you've cleared the Dragon's Den (the Rising Badge); if he's missing, do that first.

quests.title: Island Forest (Six Island): before the Lucky Meowth God
evidence: The Island Forest changes for good only if you let Jessie, James and Meowth stay on Six Island and then walk into the forest ([Six Island: Deoxys and the Lucky Meowth God](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#six-island-deoxys-and-the-lucky-meowth-god-post-game)). **Do these first:** after that, the people below stay where they are, but they switch to other lines and their quests can no longer be done. Choose "Pay and go through", or "Force your way through" and beat him (Ursaring, Zangoose, Tauros, Drapion, all Lv. 63). Paying only gets you through that once; after a win, the path is free from then on.
- **The stolen doll:** Hiker Brown (about 9 steps east of the west entrance) wants a battle (Golem 62, Donphan 63, Vigoroth 64, Honchkrow 65). Win to get the **Spoils** (a key item). Give it to the crying girl about 9 steps south of the west entrance ("Give it back"): **TM20 Safeguard**.
- **The wishing pond** (a girl in the middle of the forest, about 10 steps east of a Trainer with a Flygon): give her an **Amulet Coin** (once). She throws it in and asks for your wish:

| Wish | Effect |
|---|---|
| I want to get rich overnight | flavour only |
| **I want to be more attractive** | **clears every romance "not this partner" mark** (Green/Red, Misty, Yellow, Cynthia, Blue and others), so partners you had closed off can be won back. It no longer does anything once you've been to the Dream World. |
| I want to get stronger | flavour only |
| I don't really have a wish | flavour only |

quests.title: Island Cave (Four Island): Crystal Onix and Granny Lisa
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** any time after you reach Four Island. Talk to the craftsman first; until then the man at the passage blocks the way (tested in an emulator).

**How it works:**
1. Talk to the stone craftsman in the Stone Workshop. He's hunting for the legendary **Crystal Onix**.
2. In the Island Cave, go to the north-west corner. Until you've talked to the craftsman, a man stands in front of the passage there ("There's nothing in the cave up ahead") and you can't get past; afterwards he's gone. Go through it: you come out in a small area, and the old woman is about ten steps west of where you arrive. Walk up to her. She is patching a wounded Onix with Dawn Stones and attacks you as a "crooked merchant": **Medium Lisa** (Ledian 62, Misdreavus 63, Roselia 64, Seadra 65).
3. She explains that craftsmen cut crystal from its body twenty years ago, and begs you not to tell anyone. Answer:
**Notes:** **one chance.** The Onix disappears as soon as the battle starts, so if you knock it out, run or white out, it's gone. Save first and bring Poké Balls. The choice can't be undone.

quests.title: Island Cave: small extras
evidence:
- **Breeder Holly**, just south-east of the Sky Pillar Peak exit. Before you join the Island Pilgrimage on Seven Island, and again after you complete it, she heals your party for free. During the pilgrimage she offers a battle and fully heals you if you win; after the Team Rocket scene at Sky Pillar Peak (until the pilgrimage is over) she only says that Team Rocket wrecked the pilgrimage (no battle, no heal).
- Ruin Maniac Jules (he dug up stones and his Pokémon evolved), Hiker Everest ("You came to climb too, right?") and the other Island Cave climbers: optional battles, no reward.

quests.title: Five Island: the Island Pilgrimage leg (Five Island trials)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** during the Island Pilgrimage, after the [Seven Island start](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#seven-island-the-island-pilgrimage-start-and-final-trial).

**How it works:**
1. **Monk at the south entrance:** say you're here for the pilgrimage and beat Sage Huijin (Sunflora Lv. 62 lead).
2. **Monk on the east path** (about 20 steps south of the Elder's hut): he wants proof of your catching skill: *"a round Pokémon that is red and green"*. Catch a **Cherubi** in Five Island's grass and show it to him (party select). Any other Pokémon is refused; retry freely.
3. **Snowy mountain.** The monk at the foot of the mountain tells you it's closed. Choose to push on anyway and beat Sage Huiming. Then the next monk further up stops you; beat Sage Huiwu (Bronzong Lv. 62 lead).
4. **The freezing disciple** at the top, with his Snover: talk to him ("Why are you here?"). He's cold and hungry, and surprised anyone came up, since the Elder forbade it.
5. Go to the **Elder** in the monks' hut (north-east of the island) and pass his quiz and battle first ([Five Island: the Elder's quiz and battle](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#five-island-the-elders-quiz-and-battle)). Then talk to him again and pick "The man on the snowy mountain?". He explains that five years ago, while he was away, the disciple trusted strangers and let Team Rocket take Mew, and that he sent him up the mountain as punishment. He agrees to forgive the disciple. Climb back up and tell him "The Elder says you can come down". He leaves with his Snover.
**Reward:** beating the Elder passes the Five Island trial. Freeing the disciple is optional for the pilgrimage; it opens the **Mew** hunt ([Mew: the long hunt](#mew-the-long-hunt-five-island-finale)).
**Notes:** a loss in any trial battle whites you out. Just try again.

quests.title: Five Island: the four-leaf clover (speak up for him)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** while the sick Trainer is there. If you've already met the examiner of the **Viridian Gym Virtue trial** (he asks you to help someone in Viridian City), the sick Trainer is gone and the hunter only says "a four-leaf clover should be growing somewhere around here!". To start it then, go into the house by the One Island ferry (south-west of Five Island). If a sick Trainer is standing in front of the old monk with a Xatu at the back on the left, talk to the monk: the sick Trainer asks him about the four-leaf clover, and after that the scene by the tree can play.

**Notes:** one chance: the scene doesn't repeat. If there's no sick Trainer in the ferry house either, the clover scene can't be started for now. That visitor comes and goes with some Johto story scenes.

quests.title: Five Island: the monk's hungry Snorlax (→ Yellow Flute)
evidence: **Notes:** you need at least one of each for the option to appear, and all five of each for it to work. The monk sweeping leaves just south-west of the Elder's hut door gives **3 Lava Cookies + 3 Old Gateaux** when you beat him ("the strongest Trainer on Five Island"; his team is Lv. 88–89). That's a start; the Rare Candies you must bring yourself.

quests.title: Five Island: water for Croagunk (→ PP Max)
Mew: the long hunt (Five Island finale)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** after you've freed the Five Island disciple ([Five Island: the Island Pilgrimage leg](#five-island-the-island-pilgrimage-leg-five-island-trials), step 5). Mew then shows itself in several places. Each sighting only happens once the previous one has.

quests.title: Alto Mare Library (One Island): the legends quiz
Secret Forest (One Island): Latios, Latias and the Soul Dew
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** during the League HQ investigation: after the [Lake of Rage scene](12-lake-of-rage-to-sinjoh.md#lake-of-rage-petrel-at-the-lake-guardians-house-league-hq-round-4-continues-pokémon-league-mt-silver-and-new-bark-towns-league-hq-entry) (round 4). Talk to Bianca in the Alto Mare Library first (she's there once you've signed up for the Island Pilgrimage on Seven Island); the girl then appears on One Island (One Island, [Sevii Islands and Indigo Plateau](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md)).

**Notes:** you need **two free party slots** (four or fewer Pokémon). Otherwise he says to sort your party and waits; saying no works the same way. Afterwards, the fountain in the garden fully heals your party. Stand at the fountain with **Latias leading your party** for a short extra scene. It only plays after your final Hall of Fame entry ([The Hall of Fame](07-league-to-cherrygrove.md#the-hall-of-fame-what-your-two-entries-unlock)), so come back later.

quests.title: Alto Mare Waters: Charmander's owner and the lifeguard
Alto Mare Waters → islands → back: the Manaphy Egg
evidence:
**How it works:**
1. She asks how to hatch an Egg. Answer "Walk around with the Egg". She sets off.
2. Follow her trail. She reappears in turn on **Six Island** (south-west of the Island Forest's east entrance, near a man with a Crawdaunt), **Five Island** (about 10 steps east of the One Island ferryman) and **Four Island** (about 14 steps south of one of the Island Cave entrances). Talk to her each time (she says she'll take the Egg somewhere else).
3. Back in the Alto Mare Waters (west part, about 16 steps south of Charmander's owner), the Egg hatches into **Manaphy**. Two treasure hunters try to snatch it: double battle (Shady Guys Sterling and Wells, Lv. 62–65).
4. She asks you to look after it. Talk to Manaphy and say yes.
**Reward:** **Manaphy, Lv. 1** (needs a free party slot).
**Notes:** each appearance only shows up after you've talked to her at the previous stop.

quests.title: Alto Mare Waters / Mt. Mortar: small extras
evidence:
- **Your biggest fan** (Alto Mare Waters, west part, with a Lapras, about 15 steps north of Charmander's owner): battle her once for a **Heart Scale**.
- **Mt. Mortar (2F):** a Hoenn Trainer with a Sceptile, about 10 steps north and 8 west of where you arrive on 2F, offers repeatable Single or Double battles ("I'll practice battling with you") and will lead you back to the entrance whenever you ask ("How do I get out of the cave?").

quests.title: Two Island: Granny Mae's ultimate-move trial
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** from your first visit to the islands (after the Saffron incident). **Required for the story:** the Viridian Gym stays closed until you pass this trial. The trial only starts with two challengers. Talk to the receptionist alone first: she tells you to find a partner. Then invite the Johto Trainer on Two Island; **Blue** turns up instead and waits at the reception ([Two Island: a partner for Granny Mae's trial](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#two-island-a-partner-for-granny-maes-trial)).

**How it works:** talk to the receptionist with Blue there. There's no quitting halfway; the guards send you back if you try.
1. **Singles assessment:** Veteran Logan (Flygon 72, Typhlosion 72 …).
2. **Knowledge quiz:** walk up to the quiz guide. Five questions. You answer all five before she tells you whether you passed. If you got any wrong, walk back up to her to take the quiz again (no penalty).

3. **Doubles assessment:** Ace Trainer Charles (Abomasnow, Jynx, Glalie, Mamoswine, all Lv. 73), a Double Battle.
4. **Aptitude check:** a single battle against **Blue** (Pidgeot 75, Rhydon 74, Alakazam 74, Blastoise 76).
5. **Granny Mae's test:** a Multi Battle with Blue at your side against **Granny Mae** (Skarmory, Kingdra, Altaria, Dragonite, Lv. 75) and **Aroma Lady Dana** (Vileplume, Tentacruel, Rotom, Azumarill, Lv. 74). Stages 3, 4 and 5 run straight into each other as one scene: once you step up to Charles, you don't get control back until the Multi Battle is over, so nothing heals you between these three battles (only items used during a battle). **Heal before you walk up to Charles.** Your party is healed after the Multi Battle.

quests.title: Two Island: Fern's "sick" Chatot (Chatot needed)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** any time. The first Pokémon in your party that isn't fainted **must be a Chatot**.

quests.title: One Island: the composer's title → Miracle Seed → TM86 Grass Knot
evidence: **Notes:** the woman may never offer the trade. Her "already given" marker is shared with [Misty's Gyarados gift](02-pewter-to-vermilion.md#route-3-mistys-gyarados-comfort-misty-romance-choice) and with the early end of the [Viridian Gym trials](01-pallet-to-pewter.md#viridian-gym-the-wisdom-quiz-two-ways-to-pass). If either of those has happened, she treats you as already served and only explains how Grass Knot works (see [Known issues](known-issues.md#sevii-islands-and-indigo-plateau)).

quests.title: One Island: the Island Restaurant's battle meals (repeatable)
evidence: **Notes:** repeatable as often as you can pay. The snack set is an easy source of the Lava Cookies and Old Gateaux that the [Five Island monk's Snorlax](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#five-island-the-monks-hungry-snorlax--yellow-flute) wants. The Treecko owner in a nearby house (the north-west door of the town) teaches Grass Whistle for a Rare Candy ([tutor list](/tutors/)).

quests.title: Victory Road: the Indigo Conference qualifiers (find the hidden staff member)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** end of Kanto, the first time you enter the gate. The guard a few steps inside the gate's south entrance (the door from the League reception gate) only lets you in with the **Earth Badge** (he talks about "eight Badges", but the Earth Badge is the only one he actually checks).

**How it works:**
1. **Opening ceremony.** Walk north into the middle of the hall, where the competitors are gathered, and the MC explains the rules. A League staff member is disguised as one of the competitors. Beat that person to learn the password. You must uncover the disguised staff member to advance; knowing the number alone does not skip the trial.
2. **No Escape Ropes.** The receptionist standing in front of the cave door at the north end of the hall asks if you've got rid of your Escape Ropes. If any are still in your Bag she turns you back. Sell them to the clerk just beside her and talk to her again.
3. **Beat Janine on 2F first.** Ninja Girl **Janine** stands openly on Victory Road 2F, west side, a few steps north of the stairs up from 1F: Crobat, Venomoth, Ditto, Swalot, all Lv. 75. Beating her is what unlocks the reveal on 3F. After the battle she disappears.
4. **Find the disguised Janine on 3F.** Misty (south-east corner of 3F, near the stairs from 2F) passes on Green's/Red's hint: "Just because you've seen someone doesn't mean they're who you saw." Once you've beaten Janine on 2F, **talk to one particular 3F Trainer**. It doesn't matter whether you've battled them before. Who it is depends on your gender, your starter and your Route 11 choice ([Route 11: cut the grass or save it](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#route-11-cut-the-grass-or-save-it-choose-a-side)):

The right Trainer greets you with a new line (Wendy: "Did you come over because you caught a whiff of my perfume?"; Damon: "Behold my Fire Style: Fireball Jutsu!") and battles you. Beat them and Janine reveals herself: your password is **570819**. A wrong Trainer battles you if you haven't beaten them yet, and otherwise just gives their usual line (Axel, for one, says he hasn't found the staff member either). All five are Lv. 73–74 two-Pokémon teams.
5. **The exit guards.** With the real password, the two Trainers blocking the exit path fight you: a double battle against Ace Trainer Shane (Gastrodon, Clefairy, Hippowdon, Gallade, Lv. 75) and Guitarist Del (Tyranitar, Golem, Aerodactyl, Probopass, Lv. 75). After the win they stay put: talk to either of them again from the south and he steps aside.
6. Give the password to the staff member standing in the exit at the north end of 3F. You pass and go up to the Indigo Plateau.
**Reward:** entry to the main tournament (next entry).

**Notes:** any lost battle whites you out; the qualifier state is kept, so just go back. Without beating Janine on 2F first, nobody on 3F reveals anything, and that is the usual reason players get stuck. Firebreather Damon may give you a fake password ("Specious") instead; the exit guards just laugh at it. Use the table to find the disguised Janine.

quests.title: Indigo Plateau: the Indigo Conference main tournament and the "who do you cheer for?" choice (romance)
evidence: **Where:** the Indigo Plateau, after the qualifiers.

| Choice | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Cheer for Misty** | you watch Misty's match. **Steven's** route closes. |
| **Cheer for Steven** | you watch Steven's match. **Misty's** route closes. |
| No, get ready for my match | **both** Misty's and Steven's routes close. |

Misty is a partner for male players, Steven for female players, so a male player who wants Misty should cheer for Misty and a female player who wants Steven should cheer for Steven. The [Island Forest wish](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#island-forest-six-island-before-the-lucky-meowth-god) can reopen a closed route later.
4. Stage two moves up to the League HQ plaza: you face **Steven** (Skarmory, Aggron, Claydol, Armaldo, Cradily, Metagross, Lv. 82–83), then the semifinal against **Karen** (Skuntank, Weavile, Absol, Houndoom, Honchkrow, Zoroark, Lv. 84–85). Nurses on the plaza heal you between rounds.
**Reward:** the story continues. There is no item for the choice.

quests.title: Three Island: the biker Big Sis who can't ride
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** once you've beaten the entrance guards and got into the town ([Three Island: the Alto Mare Bikers](05-saffron-cinnabar.md#three-island-the-alto-mare-bikers-save-the-meowth)). A biker at the top of the bridge just south of her house won't let you go south, towards the Shipyard Ruins, until you've talked to her and picked one of the first three answers (tested in an emulator: before that he stops you and sends you back; afterwards you walk straight past). **Missable:** once you clear the Dragon's Den (Clair, Rising Badge), she's gone with the rest of the gang.

quests.title: Shipyard Ruins (Three Island): the bikers' Chief, a bribe or a fight
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** during the Three Island biker occupation, after you've talked to [Big Sis](#three-island-the-biker-big-sis-who-cant-ride) (until then the biker at the top of the bridge south of her house won't let you come this way). **Missable:** once you finish the Dragon's Den (Clair, Rising Badge), the bikers are gone for good and Three Island becomes a tourist spot anyway.

**How it works:** the Chief is **Roughneck Paxton**, the old Kanto Speed Alliance leader from [Cycling Road](04-celadon-fuchsia-saffron.md#cycling-road-join-the-kanto-speed-alliance-or-drive-it-out). Whatever you answer to "Do you remember me?", he offers you a red envelope.
- **Accept the red envelope:** you get **$200,000** and leave. The bikers stay. The next time you walk down the path south of the One Island Pokémon Center (towards the harbour, next to the tourist who asks if it's your first time in the islands), a **League discipline inspector** fines you **$400,000**, double the bribe (all your money if you have less). After that you can come back and fight, but Big Sis is no longer on your side (see the gauntlet's last step).
- **Refuse:** a gauntlet, with no healing in between (a loss whites you out):
  1. Bikers Yancy + Hugh (Double Battle, Lv. 62–64).
  2. Bikers Lucky + Bert (Double Battle).
  3. Biker Muramasa again (same team as at the door).
  4. If you **taught Big Sis to ride** and didn't take the bribe, she switches sides and you face **Paxton + Black Belt Doyle** together. Otherwise you face Doyle + Big Sis (Double Battle), then **Paxton** alone (Tentacruel, Lunatone, Snorlax, Cacturne, Rhyperior, Umbreon; Lv. 81–82).
  The gang gives up Three Island and leaves.
**Reward:** no item from the Chief. **Win the gauntlet** and a man who wants to rebuild the island appears on Three Island, a few steps west of the northern house door (the same man who asked you, in the One Island Pokémon Center, to drive the bikers off). He gives you a **Protector**. Missable: he's only there between the gauntlet and the Dragon's Den clear, which hides him again. Players who only take the bribe never get it. The tourist spot and the Three Island pilgrimage trial come from finishing the Dragon's Den, whether or not you fought.

**Notes:** you can take the bribe again after the fine, but each time you're fined again at One Island ($400,000) and must beat Muramasa at the door again, so it always loses money. Taking the bribe even once cancels Big Sis's help: after the fine the game treats her as never having been taught, and she has already left her house, so you can't teach her again.

quests.title: Four Island: the Mystery Stone buyer (don't sell it)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** once you carry Mr. Fuji's **Mystery Stone** ([Lavender Town: Mr. Fuji's gifts](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#lavender-town-mr-fujis-gifts-after-the-tower)) and before the **Rising Badge**.
**Notes:** after the Rising Badge he no longer buys the stone, so you can't sell it then.

quests.title: Four Island: small extras (Stone Workshop)
evidence:
- **The Garchomp veteran** (in the house next to the Stone Workshop: the south-east of the two house doors in town; he's right inside): accept his battle (Garchomp 65, Butterfree, Pidgeot, Kingler, Muk, Tauros). **Losing** gives you a **Dawn Stone** ("an old man like me could still beat a youngster"); winning gives nothing. No white-out either way. One time.
- **The rough-stone seller** (inside the Stone Workshop, the north-west of the two house doors): $50,000 for a rock "full of evolution stones". It is always empty. Don't buy it.
- **The Nugget digger** in town (a few steps south of the cave entrance on the west side) gives a **Nugget**, once.

3. Walk up towards the Red Star (the scene starts a few steps north-west of the chief's door). Team Rocket's Petrel and Marauder beat the chief and his friend, while Maxie and Archie shine the Red and Blue Orbs on the stone. You fight **Executive Marauder** (Tyranitar 90 …) and **Executive Petrel** (Nidoking 87 …) together in a Double Battle. A loss whites you out and you can retry.
4. After your win, the stone wakes **Deoxys**. Petrel catches it with a special ball and they escape. The chief confirms you've passed the Six Island trial and begs you to bring Deoxys back.

quests.title: Cerulean Cave: Giovanni's duel and the Charizardite
evidence: **Where:** Cerulean Cave, the hidden hall deep inside, after Nurse Joy's invitation letter.

**Who gets it / when:** after your first Hall of Fame (Giovanni congratulates you on becoming Champion). This is a story scene for every player. Only the Charizardite is restricted: it only happens if you **chose Charmander** in Oak's lab **and** still carry Mr. Fuji's **Mystery Stone** ([Lavender Town: Mr. Fuji's gifts](03-vermilion-to-celadon.md#lavender-town-mr-fujis-gifts-after-the-tower); don't sell it to the [Four Island buyer](06-sevii-islands-indigo.md#four-island-the-mystery-stone-buyer-dont-sell-it)).

**How it works:**
1. Giovanni battles you with his full **Lv. 100** team (Mewtwo, Tyranitar, Nidoking, Rhydon, Nidoqueen, Aerodactyl). Losing doesn't white you out. If you **win**, Mewtwo uses Recover and the same battle starts again, as often as you keep winning. The duel only moves on once you lose.
2. You wake up "at the bottom of the lake". With Charmander and the Mystery Stone, the stone reacts: it becomes a **[Charizardite](/items/charizardite/)**. Without either, the scene just continues.
3. Rematch: a Double Battle against Giovanni's team, sent out two at a time; he opens with Mewtwo and Tyranitar (tested in an emulator). **A loss here whites you out.** Giovanni stays, but to retry you have to talk to him again and replay the whole scene: the duel, the collapse and the lake.
4. After the win you free Mewtwo and Giovanni escapes. You wake up at home, and Prof. Oak sends you to Mt. Silver (the rehabilitation below).
**Reward:** Charizardite (Charmander starters with the Mystery Stone only).

**Notes:** the [Dragon Shrine](12-lake-of-rage-to-sinjoh.md#dragon-shrine-the-mystery-stone-becomes-a-charizardite-and-the-dragon-rush-tutor) in Johto's Dragon's Den can also turn the Mystery Stone into a Charizardite. It works for any starter; only this cave scene checks for Charmander.

quests.title: Mt. Silver lodge: the rehabilitation (how to move it along)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** story, right after the Cerulean Cave duel. You can't go to Johto until it's done.

**How it works:** Sabrina runs a loop. Each round is **talk to Sabrina → battle → examine the hot spring → you rest a while → talk to Sabrina again**.
1. Talk to Sabrina. She tells you to try the hot spring first. Examine the spring (the game puts your walking Pokémon away first). This first soak moves the story on.
2. Round 1: **Brock**, then soak. Round 2: **Misty**, then soak. Round 3: **Blue**, then soak. Round 4: **Sabrina** herself, and in the same visit **Yellow** walks in and battles you straight away (no soak in between); she finishes the cure.
3. After each battle, Sabrina says "go soak in the hot spring". Until you do, she just repeats that line. Soaking puts you back in the lodge, having rested "a while longer", for the next round.
4. After Yellow, soak once more. Sabrina joins you in the spring, then you go home to Pallet Town.
**Notes:** every soak fully heals your party. You can soak as often as you like; only the first soak after each battle moves the story on.

quests.title: Cherrygrove City: Crystal, the orphanage and Rhett's Slugma (story chain; where to go next)

Ruins of Alph: the missing Molly (story chapter; how to move it along)
evidence:

1. **Research Center:** talk to the assistant by the entrance. Molly, Prof. Hale's 6-year-old daughter, has vanished.
2. **Ask Gold** (a few steps north-west of the Research Center door) **and Crystal** (south of the small building in the middle of the ruins) about Molly. Answer Yes to "Ask … about Molly?" for **both**. Only then does Silver appear in the north-east (Kabuto) chamber.

4. **"Right, Idol?"** Escape Rope, Dig and Fly all fail. Keep choosing until the new option **"I don't know either"** appears, and pick it. Molly and Entei appear → battle **Entei**. Then **touch the statue** on the right (Yes).
5. **Dream world:** Molly's clone battles you. Then help your three friends, each in a **Multi Battle**: Silver (north), Gold (middle), Crystal (south). The staircase to the sky stays shut ("Let's wait until everyone's here") until all three are won.
6. Climb the steps: Entei attacks. Your party is fully healed once, then you fight **two Double Battles** in a row, both against **Entei's team**, sent out two at a time. Molly agrees to leave.
7. Back at the Research Center you get the **Unown Report**.

**How it works:**
1. Talk to her: she scraped her knee. "Do you have a Potion I could borrow?" → **Yes** with a **Potion** in your Bag. She takes it, thanks you, and asks you to find out why her face appeared on a statue underground. (No: "You don't...?". Yes without a Potion: "Liar. You don't even have a Potion." 2. Go to the **Underground Hall** (enter the small building in the middle of the ruins and go down). Examine the **fourth statue from the left in the top row**: "{your name}'s face slowly appeared on the statue! Touch it?" → Yes → wild **Bronzor, Lv. 25** (beat it, catch it or run away). Before step 1 the statue is just "a replica of an ancient Pokémon."
3. Go back and tell her.

**Notes:** losing to Bronzor whites you out and you can try again. Tested in an emulator (Chinese ROM and English build): without a Potion she calls you a liar; with one, the Potion is taken, the statue starts the Bronzor battle (running away also counts), and she then gives the Rock Incense.

quests.title: Ruins of Alph: Giovanni catches Arceus (League HQ lead)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** right after Team Rocket takes the Azure Flute at the Ritual Shrine on Seven Island. The shrine keeper sends you after them to the Ruins of Alph.

**How it works:**
1. Get into the hall. The Kabuto chamber's back wall closed again at the end of the Ruins of Alph chapter, so reopen the back wall of any of the four chambers ([the chamber walls](13-dungeons-and-common.md#ruins-of-alph-the-four-stone-panels-and-the-chamber-walls-continues-cherrygrove-city-to-azalea-towns-ruins-of-alph-entries)).
2. Walk to the end of the hall with the stone replica statues, west of the temple door. Giovanni, Cyrus, Charon and Archer are waiting there. Giovanni plays the Azure Flute and everyone is taken to the temple of Arceus (the Sinjoh Ruins).
3. Three battles follow, with **no healing in between**:
   - **Executive Cyrus**: Murkrow, Weavile, Gyarados, Crobat, Weezing, Aggron (Lv. 89–90).
   - Giovanni catches **Regigigas**, which was hiding in the temple. Then **Executive Charon**: Dragonite, Feraligatr, Dusclops, Magnezone, Cloyster, Coalossal (Lv. 87–88).
   - Giovanni calls out Dialga, Palkia and Giratina. Then **Executive Archer**: a **Double Battle** against his team, sent out two at a time (Ho-Oh Lv. 95, Torkoal, Houndoom, Electrode, Shiftry, Muk, Lv. 91–92). His Torkoal brings harsh sunlight.
4. Arceus appears. It refuses Giovanni's ball, and it pushes you away too, because you don't have the Azure Flute. Giovanni fights it with Beedrill, Nidoking and Rhydon (you only watch), catches it with a replica Master Ball and leaves with Palkia.
5. Walk out of the temple at the bottom to get back to the hall.

**Notes:** losing any of the three battles whites you out, and the scene starts again when you walk back to the statues. After your final Hall of Fame entry, Regigigas and Arceus can be caught in the temple ([Sinjoh Ruins (temple of Arceus): Regigigas and Arceus](12-lake-of-rage-to-sinjoh.md#sinjoh-ruins-temple-of-arceus-regigigas-and-arceus-after-the-final-hall-of-fame)).

quests.title: Azalea Gym: Bugsy's no-type-advantage battle (the Hive Badge)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** Bugsy is away in Ilex Forest until you finish the Ilex Forest bug-catching story. Until then the Gym guide says he's out, and Bugsy isn't in the Gym.

**How it works:** Bugsy asks you to fight **without any Pokémon strong against Bug**. He calls it a 4-on-4 match, but the game never actually counts your party, so you can most likely bring six (see [Known issues](known-issues.md#cherrygrove-city-to-azalea-town)). He checks your **party** against a fixed list of 203 species (Eggs are skipped). If any of them is in your party he refuses ("None of your Pokémon can have a type that's strong against Bug").
- The list is essentially every Fire-, Flying- and Rock-type (Charmander line, Pidgey line, Geodude line, Gyarados, Scyther, Pinsir, Skarmory, Volcarona, Talonflame…). It also bans a few you might not expect, because of this hack's type changes and forms: **Conkeldurr, Tangrowth, Grumpig and Cursola** are part Rock here; **Lumineon and Sirfetch'd** are part Flying; **Cherrim** (its Sunshine Form is Grass/Fire), **Rotom** (Heat and Fan forms) and **Shaymin** (Sky Forme, a form you can't get here) are banned as a whole species because one of their forms has a banned type.
- Some Pokémon with those types are *not* on it: **Hippowdon** (Ground/Rock in this hack) and 55 Fire, Flying or Rock species from after Sinnoh. (Altaria and Tropius aren't Flying here: Altaria is Dragon/Fairy and Tropius is Grass/Dragon.) Check your party before you go in.
- His team: Scyther Lv. 80, Escavalier 80, Heracross 80, Volcarona 80.

**Rematch:** after the badge, talk to him again → Singles or Doubles (Doubles needs two Pokémon). Level 86–87 team, no type restriction. After a rematch win he repeats his "None of your Pokémon can have a type…" line instead of a victory line; it means nothing. After your final Hall of Fame entry he is away on **Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays**. Before that he's there every day.
**Notes:** the Gym guide by the entrance teaches **Megahorn** once you have the Hive Badge (see the [tutor list](/tutors/)).

2. Talk to the master: he recognises you and asks to spar → **Yes** → battle Black Belt Collier (Farfetch'd Lv. 62, Ursaring 63, Exploud 64, Lickilicky 65). Losing blacks you out; you can retry.
3. After the win, the master teaches **Solar Blade** as often as you like (listed in the [tutor table](/tutors/)).

3. **Do the Ariados rock before the Skorupi rock.** If Ariados is still up a tree, spreading Honey on Skorupi's rock draws both bugs, and one of them flees.

quests.title: Ilex Forest / Forest of Time: Sammy and the injured Celebi (League HQ round 3)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** during the League HQ investigations ([League HQ: the Trainer Affairs Department's investigations](07-league-to-cherrygrove.md#league-hq-the-trainer-affairs-departments-investigations-where-to-go-next)), round 3: "people in black in Ilex Forest". The scene plays when you talk to the ranger at that stage. Before it she only tells the Celebi legend.

AFTER THE TWO GRUNTS

Find your way through the forest

Start in the clearing where you healed Celebi. Take these five exits in order.

Top-middle → top-middle → top-right → top-left → top-middle.

Enter the side paths sideways. Walk right into the top-right exit and left into the top-left exit. Walking up onto them does nothing.

↳ Upper forest · Continue north to find Sammy and Celebi.

Lost, or being sent back?

If you’ve lost track, return to the clearing where you healed Celebi and start from exit 1. You arrive standing on an exit each time; step off it before choosing the next one.

The final exit loops back while you’re still fetching the medicine. After healing Celebi and winning the Grunt battle, the route is open.

**Notes:** every loss blacks you out, and you can retry. Only Fresh Water and the lead Pokémon are checked. The Sitrus Berries are never checked, and nothing is taken from your Bag (see [Known issues](known-issues.md#ilex-forest-and-goldenrod-city)).

quests.title: Forest of Time: the shrine, Shaymin and Celebi (Gracidea; time of day)

**How it works:**

Shaymin appears → "Let Shaymin join your party?" → Yes: **Shaymin Lv. 90**.
2. **Celebi** (after Shaymin): leave through Ilex Forest and come back first (Shaymin's appearance closes the shrine for the rest of that visit). Then lead with **Shaymin** and examine the shrine between **20:00 and 7:59**. Celebi appears → Yes: **Celebi Lv. 90**.
3. With the wrong lead or at the wrong hour, the shrine only shows its description.

**Notes:** if you answer No, the Pokémon stays on the shrine: talk to it again to be asked again. Once you leave the Forest of Time, it only comes back after you walk back into Ilex Forest itself and return. Your party needs a free slot. The times go by the hour on your DS clock.

evidence: **Who gets it / when:** from your arrival in Goldenrod until the Route 37 scene with Silver. That scene decides the outcome for good. **Finish the Ilex Forest bug hunt first** (see Notes).

- **This quest shares its progress with the bug hunt's Ariados.** On the normal path (hunt finished) it starts clean. If you left Ilex Forest in the middle of the hunt, the act can start as soon as you enter the girl's house, the clinic choice can be skipped, or the game can count it as "Purugly kept". Finishing the hunt after starting this quest wipes your Purugly progress. *(Suspected hack bug.)*

quests.title: Romance route: how it's unlocked, how your partner is chosen, and what locks a partner out (central entry)
evidence: Origin HeartGold has a hidden romance route. You pick **one** partner and confess in the final chapter. The scripts then offer post-game dates for some partners only, and moving in appears unreachable for everyone (table in step 4). Four steps decide it. **Steps 1 and 2 are missable:** the love reading must come before the MooMoo Farm investigation, which the League HQ's round-3 order opens after the Silver Conference.
### 1. The love reading (Goldenrod fortune-teller; before the MooMoo Farm investigation)

After the ideal-Pokémon reading (entry above), talk to the fortune-teller again and choose **"My love fortune"** ($10,000; she refuses if you have less). She asks up to five questions. Only one set of answers works:

| Question | Answer that works |
|---|---|
| "Would you be happy to have a companion who secretly adores you?" | **I'd be glad to be liked** ("Just friends is better" ends the reading here) |
| "Could you accept a romance with more than two people?" | **No, I'm loyal to one** |
| "What kind of person are you hoping fate brings you together with?" | **The opposite sex** |
| "At what age do you think it's OK to start dating?" | **After 10** |
| "What do you think matters most in a relationship?" | **Shared memories** or **Mutual attraction** |

**Partner check (optional, repeatable, $10,000 each):** after a "near future" result, "My love fortune" lets you name a friend. Male players: Green, Misty, Yellow, Cynthia, Crystal. Female players: Blue, Red, Steven, Gold, Silver. "The two of you share a special bond" means that partner is still open. "The bond between you two has run its course" means they're locked out. Use it to check your earlier choices (table below).
The fortune-teller stops offering "My love fortune" once you've fought Will and Karen in the Dream World (step 2). **Do the reading before the MooMoo Farm investigation.**

The MooMoo Farm investigation (sick Miltank, Route 39; [MooMoo Farm: the sick Miltank investigation](10-ecruteak-olivine.md#moomoo-farm-the-sick-miltank-investigation-league-hq-round-3-leads-to-the-dream-world)) only opens with the League HQ's **round-3 order** ([League HQ](07-league-to-cherrygrove.md#league-hq-the-trainer-affairs-departments-investigations-where-to-go-next)), after the Silver Conference. That order makes the farm's Miltank sick. Until then they're healthy and the farmer only talks about his milk, so you can't get to the Dream World earlier. The investigation is one of the round's leads, so everyone goes through it. It ends with Will and Karen opening a rift in the stable, and you're pulled into the **Dream World**.

Then walk west or east to the story scene: Will catches Cresselia (west) and Karen catches Darkrai (east). They team up against you in a **Double Battle** (Rocket Elites Will and Karen, six Pokémon each, Lv. 90). Losing whites you out. They leave you stranded, and **the old man disappears after this battle**. To get out, examine the broken statue at the north end of the Dream World. It gives you a **Lunar Wing** if you don't have one. Examine it again with the Lunar Wing to return to the MooMoo Farm stable.

**When you leave through the statue without having named a partner** (no love reading, a "distant future" result, answering No, choosing "No one", or doing the battle before you talk to him), **every partner is locked out**.

quests.title: Goldenrod City: small extras
evidence:
- **Gold's slot winnings:** before you record the Radio Tower show, Gold and his newly hatched Togepi are at the Game Corner slots, in the middle of the slot rows. If you have a **Coin Case** he gives you **1,000 coins** (once). Without one he just talks, and you can come back later while he's still there.
- **Bike Shop:** the owner gives you a **Pass** (the Magnet Train Pass to Saffron) as thanks for "beating the bikers outside". You need it at the station gate.
- **Revive from a fan:** a kid standing west of the Pokémon Center, a few steps north of the south Tunnel entrance, gives you a **Revive** because he saw you on TV.
- **Pokémon Center Budew trade:** the girl who wants a Budew is the in-game trade listed under [Goldenrod City's gifts and trades](/locations/goldenrod-city/#special).
- **Flower Shop** (north-east of town, next to the Gym): Saki greets you. If you're **carrying a Gracidea**, she tells you to take it to the shrine deep in Ilex Forest (Forest of Time) to meet Shaymin. With **Shaymin** as your lead she hints that it may lead you to Celebi at the same shrine. With **Celebi** as your lead she praises it. The shop sells herbs, Rose Incense ($9,000), Mulch, and Berry Pots ($5,000) if you don't have them.
- **Daily Drawing (Dept. Store 6F):** $300 a draw. Prizes change by weekday (1st/2nd prize): Sun Heart Scale/Fast Ball, Mon Sacred Ash/Level Ball, Tue Lucky Egg/Lure Ball, Wed Rare Candy/Heavy Ball, Thu PP Max/Love Ball, Fri Old Gateau (announced as a Cherish Ball)/Friend Ball, Sat Max Elixir/Moon Ball. 3rd prize is a Berry. Each draw has a **4%** chance of 1st prize, **36%** of 2nd and **60%** of 3rd. The 3rd-prize Berry is one of Figy, Wiki, Mago, Aguav, Iapapa, Leppa or Oran, with equal chances. There's no daily limit: you can draw as often as you can pay. If your Bag is full you get your $300 back.
- **Pokémon Lottery (Radio Tower 1F):** Felicity, second from the left at the reception counter, draws a lucky number once a day and checks it against the ID No. of every Pokémon in your party and your PC boxes. Prizes by matching digits: 1 digit **Ultra Ball**, 2 **PP Up**, 3 **Protector**, 4 **Max Revive**, all 5 **Heart Scale**. Digits are counted from the end of the number, as in the original games (not confirmed in game). If nothing matches you can ask her to check again the same day, for example after catching or trading for more Pokémon. Once you've won, the next drawing is the next day. If your Bag is full she keeps your prize until you come back.
- **Whitney's photo (post-game):** after the Hall of Fame, between 6 PM and 7:59 PM, Whitney leaves the Gym and shops on Dept. Store 6F. She offers a photo with you.
- **Norman's parenting question** at the station (see the Gym entry) only changes Ruby's lines.
- **Move tutors:** a jogger in the west plaza, south of the Lopunny owner, teaches **Extreme Speed** for one **Lemonade** (from the Department Store). A man a few steps east of the Game Corner door teaches **Belly Drum** for free. (The Hyper Voice tutor by the Gym is in the Gym entry.)

quests.title: Burned Tower → Bell Tower gate: bring Morty to the Marauder (story; the gate quiz)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** the Ecruteak story chapter, after Silver's scene on Route 37.

**How it works:**
1. In the Burned Tower basement a man in a red cape (the **Marauder**) is about to smash the Sealing Mirror. Pick the option to stop him. He says he'll only listen to Morty. "I'll give you today…" is only talk: there is no real time limit.
2. Go to the Bell Tower gatehouse. The guard at the back says the tower is closed. Choose **"I'm the Champion. I need Morty."**, then **Yes** to answer his questions. All six must be right in one go; one wrong answer ends it ("Wrong answer…") and you start again from question 1. The old man on the left tells the legend if you want hints.

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| What did Ho-Oh later do for the three Pokémon that burned to death? | **Revived them** |
| Which three Pokémon are the legendary beasts? | **Raikou/Entei/Suicune** |
| What did Ho-Oh do to them to keep them from clashing with people? | **Sealed them in a mirror** |
| What did Ho-Oh choose to do itself? | **Left Ecruteak City** |
| When will Ho-Oh and the beasts return? | **When people need them** |
| What kind of Pokémon is Ho-Oh? | **Kind and forgiving** |

**Reward:** the story moves on. Afterwards Morty's Gym opens (until then a man a few steps inside the entrance says Morty is away at the Bell Tower, and he stands in the only way in), and Gold's training (below), the Aura Sphere tutor in the gatehouse and the Poltergeist disciple in the Gym appear.

quests.title: Route 38: the Murkrow that stole a coin (Nugget trap; → 2 Rare Candies, 2 Lava Cookies or keep the Amulet Coin)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** any time. One time only.

**How it works:**
1. Talk to the kid and choose **"OK, I'll get it back"**. ("Figure it out yourself" just ends the talk; you can ask again.) Until you agree, the Murkrow only cries at you.
2. Talk to the Murkrow → "Ask Murkrow for the coin?" → **Yes**.
   - **No Nugget in your Bag:** it eyes you warily and hops away to another spot on the route. Follow it and try again.
   - **With a Nugget:** "Trade the Nugget to Murkrow for the gold coin?" **Say No.** If you say Yes it takes your Nugget and then hops away to another spot, just as when you have none. The Nugget is lost; follow the Murkrow and try again with another Nugget.
   - After refusing the trade: "Beat up Murkrow and take the gold coin by force?" → **Yes** → a wild **Murkrow, Lv. 25**. Beat it (losing whites you out) and it drops the coin: an **Amulet Coin**. Catching it or running away counts as a win too: the coin still drops.
   So you need a **Nugget in your Bag** to get the fight at all, but you must refuse to hand it over.
3. Go back to the kid → "Did you get my coin back?" → **Yes** to hand over the Amulet Coin, or **No** to keep it.

quests.title: MooMoo Farm: the sick Miltank investigation (League HQ round 3; leads to the Dream World)
evidence: **Who gets it / when:** after the League HQ's round-3 order, which sends you to MooMoo Farm about ghostly rumours ([League HQ](07-league-to-cherrygrove.md#league-hq-the-trainer-affairs-departments-investigations-where-to-go-next)), after the Silver Conference. Until then they're healthy: the farmer only greets you and talks about his milk, the milk stall and the farm's seal girl are open, and the Sunflora old lady tells her story. **How it works:**
1. Talk to the farmer. "Could you please help us find out why our Miltank are sick?" → **Yes**.
2. Go into the west room and walk up to the back of the stable. Will and Karen of Team Rocket appear, open a rift into "that world" and vanish, and you're pulled into the **Dream World**.
3. The Dream World (partner choice, the Will and Karen Double Battle, the Lunar Wing and the way back) is in the [Romance route central entry, step 2](09-ilex-goldenrod.md#romance-route-how-its-unlocked-how-your-partner-is-chosen-and-what-locks-a-partner-out-central-entry) and [Dream World: Cresselia and Darkrai](09-ilex-goldenrod.md#dream-world-cresselia-and-darkrai-post-game). **Do the Goldenrod love reading before this if you want the romance route.**
4. Back at the farm, talk to the farmer again.

**Notes:**
- **Moomoo Milk stall** (the farmer's daughter at the farm entrance, a few steps south of the stable doors): 1 for $1,000, 3 for $3,000, 8 for $8,000, 12 for $12,000. Closed while the Miltank are sick.
- **After your final Hall of Fame entry**, examine the back wall of the west stable room to return to the Dream World ([Dream World: Cresselia and Darkrai](09-ilex-goldenrod.md#dream-world-cresselia-and-darkrai-post-game)). You don't need a Lunar Wing for this.
